The temple is built according to the mountain terrain, with green trees forming shade. Because there is a spring in the mountain, green in color and sweet in taste, neither overflowing nor drying up year-round, named Lingquan (Spirit Spring), hence the temple was finally named Lingquan Temple. According to records, Lingquan Temple was first built during the Sui Wendi Kaihuang era; originally the temple name was not Lingquan Temple but Shengfo (Holy Buddha) Temple. After reconstruction in the 3rd year of Hongzhi of Ming Xiaozong (1490), it was renamed Lingquan Temple. In its heyday, Lingquan Temple had extremely flourishing incense, praised as the Lingquan Sacred Realm, almost on par with Putuo Mountain in the South Sea. Today's Lingquan Mountain is still the Buddhist activity center of central Sichuan; every important festival it attracts believers from all sides gathering together, bustling and extraordinary. Passing the ticket office, after a long tree-lined path that makes one focus and calm the mind, we arrive at an open square. Here, we can see the plaque of Lingquan Temple. The building is solemn and majestic, and the characters on the plaque are also deep and forceful, all without exception showing the demeanor of this thousand-year-old ancient temple. Even just one glance fills one's heart with respect, walking calmly toward the depths of the temple. The Mahavira Hall of Lingquan Temple is 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep. It adopts a double-eave xieshan roof form, with a post-and-lintel frame, dignified yet without losing elegance. The Guanyin Pavilion is located on Guanyin Peak, the main peak of Lingquan Mountain, and is the highest point of the entire scenic area. Glazed tiles, high flying eaves, with grand momentum. Being in the serene Lingquan Sacred Realm, one cannot help but develop a heart toward goodness and cast aside distracting thoughts in the mind.

projects.name: 饶益寺
projects.address: 遂宁市射洪县柳树镇南两公里处通济山
projects.content_zh: 饶益寺坐落在遂宁市射洪县柳树镇南两公里处的通济山上，为四合院布局，结构严谨、条理有序。现存有山门、天王殿、大雄宝殿、地藏王殿、观音殿、厢房和后山门等古代建筑，保存状况较好。寺庙依地势而建，寺内古木森森，曲径通幽，一院连一院，趣味十足。由山门进入寺庙，经过天王殿，便来到了饶益寺的主体建筑——大雄宝殿。饶益寺的大雄宝殿始建于唐朝，于明代永乐九年(1411年)和明万历二年(1574年)两次维修，我们现在看到的大雄宝殿应该就是明代遗留下来的模样。大雄宝殿面阔三间，进深三间，是抬梁式梁架单檐歇山顶建筑，屋顶造型古朴美观，经历数百年风吹雨打依旧安然无恙。殿内供有大佛三尊，左右森然排列十八罗汉。大雄宝殿左右墙壁存在精彩壁画，可惜毁于十年浩劫，无法再使后人欣赏。所幸在其余殿内还有幸存一部分壁画，也让我们能够大饱眼福，少些遗憾。
projects.content_en: Raoyi Temple is located on Tongji Mountain, two kilometers south of Liushu Town, Shehong County, Suining City. It has a siheyuan layout, with rigorous structure and orderly arrangement. Currently surviving ancient buildings include the mountain gate, Heavenly Kings Hall, Mahavira Hall, Ksitigarbha Hall, Guanyin Hall, wing rooms, and rear mountain gate, etc., in relatively good preservation condition. The temple is built according to the terrain; inside the temple ancient trees are dense, winding paths lead to secluded places, one courtyard connects to another, full of interest. Entering the temple from the mountain gate, passing the Heavenly Kings Hall, one arrives at the main building of Raoyi Temple — the Mahavira Hall. The Mahavira Hall of Raoyi Temple was first built in Tang dynasty, and underwent two repairs in the 9th year of Yongle (1411) and the 2nd year of Wanli (1574) of Ming; the Mahavira Hall we see now should be the appearance left from Ming dynasty. The Mahavira Hall is 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep, a single-eave xieshan roof building with a post-and-lintel beam frame; the roof shape is simple and beautiful, having experienced hundreds of years of wind and rain still safe and sound. Inside the hall there are three large Buddha statues enshrined, with Eighteen Arhats solemnly arranged on the left and right. There are wonderful murals on the left and right walls of the Mahavira Hall; unfortunately they were destroyed in the ten-year catastrophe, and can no longer be appreciated by later generations. Fortunately, in the remaining halls there is still a surviving part of the murals, which also allows us to feast our eyes and have fewer regrets.

projects.name: 蓬溪奎塔
projects.address: 遂宁市蓬溪县赤城镇奎阁公园
projects.content_zh: 蓬溪奎塔，又名鳌峙阁，位于遂宁市蓬溪县赤城镇奎阁公园内，建于清嘉庆六年(1801年)，总占地面积约220平方米，通高约26米。奎塔坐北朝南，五重檐八角攒尖屋顶，是穿斗式与抬梁式结构混合的木结构建筑。奎塔由塔基与塔身组成。塔身呈八边形，层层内收并出檐，角檐翘起。底层对开门，内有楼梯可攀至顶层。宝顶由束腰须弥座形刹座和葫芦形刹尖组成，制作精美。塔基为条石砌筑而成，南北均为垂带踏道，共13级。奎塔内拥有许多精美的雕刻，底层的柱础、各层撑拱，雀替均为圆雕或者浮雕，人物、瑞兽、花草无一不是造型精美，显示出极高的工艺水平，古朴而不失秀气。奎塔所在处是节日里居民喝茶聊天的胜地，场面热闹非凡，极其壮观。虽然奎塔被围栏围住，让人无法靠近，但它依旧能在日常生活中给当地人民以文化熏陶，真正融入百姓生活之中，真是让人倍感欣慰。
projects.content_en: Kui Pagoda in Pengxi, also known as Aozhi Pavilion, is located in Kuige Park, Chicheng Town, Pengxi County, Suining City. It was built in the 6th year of Jiaqing (1801), Qing dynasty, with a total site area of about 220 sq m and a total height of about 26m. Kui Pagoda faces south, with a five-eave octagonal pyramidal roof; it is a timber structure building with a mixed chuan-dou and post-and-lintel structure. Kui Pagoda consists of a pagoda base and pagoda body. The pagoda body is octagonal, tapering inward layer by layer with eaves extending out, and the corner eaves curl upward. The bottom layer has opposite doors, with stairs inside that can climb to the top layer. The precious top consists of a waisted xumi-seat-style finial base and a gourd-shaped finial tip, exquisitely made. The pagoda base is built of dressed stones, with垂带-style steps on both north and south, totaling 13 levels. Inside Kui Pagoda there are many exquisite carvings; the column bases of the bottom layer, the supporting brackets of each layer, and the sparrow brackets are all round carvings or reliefs; figures, auspicious beasts, flowers and plants are all without exception exquisitely shaped, showing an extremely high level of craftsmanship, simple yet without losing elegance. The place where Kui Pagoda is located is a popular spot for residents to drink tea and chat during festivals, with a bustling and extraordinary scene, extremely spectacular. Although Kui Pagoda is surrounded by a fence, making it impossible for people to approach, it can still give local people cultural edification in daily life, truly integrating into the lives of the common people — really making one feel gratified.

projects.name: 寂光寺
projects.address: 遂宁市大英县蓬莱镇古井村
projects.content_zh: 寂光寺位于四川省遂宁市大英县蓬莱镇古井村。寂光寺为四合院布局，因为寺内有一座古井，井水甘甜，故又被称作古井寺。这口古井也是古井村地名的由来。寂光寺始建于隋大业年间，后因兵火而毁。明清年间，寺庙进行重修，留下了今天的格局。寂光寺沿着中轴线布局，沿山势向上递升，由山门、弥勒殿、大雄殿和转轮殿形成三进院落的布局形式。寂光寺的山门又称魁星楼，共两层。面阔三间，进深三间，重檐歇山顶形制。门前有小溪穿过，一道石拱桥横跨小溪，增强了纵向的轴线序列。寂光寺的大雄宝殿位于高高的台基之上，强调了大殿的地位之高。宽阔的台阶上长着低矮的草本，两旁绿树成荫，建筑与自然相得益彰。寂光寺布局严谨，建筑虽不是很多，但是气势宏伟。茂密的古树林更是给建筑增添了几分幽静。
projects.content_en: Jiguang Temple is located in Gujing (Ancient Well) Village, Penglai Town, Daying County, Suining City, Sichuan Province. Jiguang Temple has a siheyuan layout; because there is an ancient well inside the temple with sweet well water, it is also called Ancient Well Temple. This ancient well is also the origin of the place name Gujing Village. Jiguang Temple was first built during the Sui Daye era, later destroyed due to war and fire. During Ming-Qing period, the temple was rebuilt, leaving today's layout. Jiguang Temple is laid out along the central axis, ascending upward along the mountain terrain; from the mountain gate, Maitreya Hall, Mahavira Hall, and Zhuanlun (Wheel) Hall, it forms a three-courtyard layout form. The mountain gate of Jiguang Temple is also called Kuixing (Star of Literature) Tower, with two stories. It is 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep, in double-eave xieshan roof form. In front of the gate a small stream passes through, and a stone arch bridge spans the small stream, enhancing the longitudinal axis sequence. The Mahavira Hall of Jiguang Temple is located on a high platform base, emphasizing the high status of the main hall. On the broad steps grow low herbs, and on both sides green trees form shade; architecture and nature complement each other. Jiguang Temple has a rigorous layout; although there are not many buildings, the momentum is grand. The dense ancient forest even adds a touch of serenity to the buildings.

projects.name: 金仙寺
projects.address: 遂宁市蓬溪县赤脚镇金仙村
projects.content_zh: 金仙寺建于元代，位于遂宁市蓬溪县赤脚镇金仙村，交通较为不便，属于四川省第八批省级重点文物保护单位。金仙寺大殿原面阔三间，进深三间，单檐歇山顶，青瓦素屋面，朴素却又不失飘逸沉稳。大殿用料较为随意，多为天然弯木，不失元代粗犷之感。梁上刻有题记，记录了大殿于何时由何人所建，何人捐赠多少银两木料等等，丰富的题记包含了大量信息，具有一定的研究价值。同时，梁架上原绘有彩画，由于年代久远，痕迹已经不明显了。经历了无情岁月鞭挞之后，曾经拥有辉煌的金仙寺已经荒草丛生，只剩下一座破旧的大殿摇摇欲坠。由于当地人曾经将大殿当作学校，所以殿内的佛龛全部都被移走，只剩下四面漏风墙壁，空空如也，保存状况令人担忧。金仙寺是2008年才被遂宁市文物普查队发现的。不知在四川某个偏远的山沟中，是否还有一些古代瑰宝，等待着人们去发现、去保护呢？
projects.content_en: Jinxian Temple was built in Yuan dynasty, located in Jinxian Village, Chijiao Town, Pengxi County, Suining City, with relatively inconvenient transportation. It belongs to the 8th batch of Sichuan Provincial Key Cultural Relics Protection Units. The main hall of Jinxian Temple was originally 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep, with a single-eave xieshan roof and grey tile plain roof surface — simple yet without losing elegance and steadiness. The materials used in the main hall are relatively casual, mostly naturally curved timber, without losing the rough feeling of Yuan dynasty. On the beams there are carved inscriptions, recording when and by whom the main hall was built, who donated how much silver and timber, etc.; the rich inscriptions contain a large amount of information, with certain research value. At the same time, the beam frame was originally painted with colored paintings; due to the passage of time, the traces are no longer obvious. After being whipped by the merciless years, Jinxian Temple, which once had glory, has become overgrown with weeds, leaving only a dilapidated main hall crumbling. Because local people once used the main hall as a school, all the Buddhist shrines inside the hall were removed, leaving only walls leaking wind on all four sides, empty as can be; the preservation condition is worrying. Jinxian Temple was only discovered by the Suining Cultural Relics Survey Team in 2008. I wonder whether in some remote mountain valley in Sichuan there are still some ancient treasures waiting for people to discover and protect?

projects.name: 百福院
projects.address: 遂宁市船山区天上街百福巷
projects.content_zh: 百福院位于四川省遂宁市船山区天上街百福巷，地处一片较为繁华的闹市区，其破旧与周围的繁华显得格格不入。百福院原为四合院布局，分为前殿和后殿，占地面积947平方米。前殿建于明洪武年间，后院建于清乾隆年间。2002年，后殿以及右厢房被拆除，故现仅存前殿。百福院前殿面阔三间，进深三间，采用抬梁式梁架，单檐歇山顶形制，飘逸庄重，斑驳的青瓦屋面更让人感到建筑年代之久远。百福院是研究元末明初古建筑的重要实例，也是遂宁现存最早的木结构建筑物，具有重要文物价值，民间甚至有先有百福院，后有遂宁县的说法。遗憾的是，百福院的现状并不乐观。因为历史久远，前殿已经破败不堪，墙体也是四面破洞、布满各种补丁。一座历经沧桑的建筑现在已经是破破烂烂，看上去危在旦夕，实在让人心痛。
projects.content_en: Baifu Hall is located in Baifu Alley, Tianshang Street, Chuanshan District, Suining City, Sichuan Province. It is situated in a relatively bustling downtown area, and its dilapidation seems out of place with the surrounding prosperity. Baifu Hall originally had a siheyuan layout, divided into a front hall and a rear hall, covering 947 sq m. The front hall was built during the Ming Hongwu era, and the rear courtyard was built during the Qing Qianlong era. In 2002, the rear hall and right wing room were demolished, hence currently only the front hall survives. The front hall of Baifu Hall is 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep, adopting a post-and-lintel beam frame, in single-eave xieshan roof form — elegant and dignified; the mottled grey tile roof surface makes one feel even more the long age of the building. Baifu Hall is an important example for studying ancient buildings of the late Yuan and early Ming, and is also the earliest surviving timber structure building in Suining, with important cultural relic value; among the people there is even a saying that first there was Baifu Hall, then there was Suining County. Unfortunately, the current state of Baifu Hall is not optimistic. Because of its long history, the front hall has already fallen into disrepair, and the walls are also full of holes on all four sides, covered with various patches. A building that has experienced vicissitudes is now in tatters, looking as if it is in imminent danger — truly heart-wrenching.

projects.name: 大安寺
projects.address: 广元市朝天区小安乡云雾山
projects.content_zh: 大安寺在广元市朝天区小安乡内，地处偏僻的云雾山。这里交通不便，进山的巴士次数较少，也非正规，加之路崎岖而无护栏，若非经验丰富的司机带路，上山非常危险。大安寺为千年古寺，具有珍贵的文化艺术价值，于2007年成为四川省省级重点文物保护单位。大安寺始建于东汉末年，本名为圆通观，为雄踞汉中的军阀、五斗米道天师张鲁所建。唐初由尉迟敬德重修改名圆通寺。明崇祯年间，由于圆通寺住持率领弟子与张献忠军队抗争，保护了寺庙与周围地区的安宁和平，故改名为大安寺。大安寺的寺庙外围经过修复粉饰，恢复了往日的恢宏面貌，与苍木翠林，显得安详而肃穆。可惜寺内貌似多年未曾打理维护，显得残破不堪，与外墙形成鲜明的对比。殿内有一座记载着捐献寺庙重修事宜的民国石碑。此外，还有一口铁碑，据说重达千斤，是大安寺的镇寺之宝。铁碑铸于明朝，碑上镌刻有铭文《建立观音寺记》，记载圆通寺维修事宜，虽通身铁锈但保存完好，铭文依旧清晰可见。放眼望去，荒无人烟的寺内院落显得古旧而凄清，残砖破瓦随意地堆砌在房梁之上。殿内的佛像虽然庄严依旧，却也经不住岁月摧残，落满了灰尘，凄冷孤寂异常。
projects.content_en: Da'an Temple is located in Xiao'an Township, Chaotian District, Guangyuan City, on the remote Yunwu (Cloud-Mist) Mountain. Transportation here is inconvenient; there are few buses going into the mountain, and they are not regular; plus the road is rugged with no guardrails — unless guided by an experienced driver, going up the mountain is very dangerous. Da'an Temple is a thousand-year-old ancient temple with precious cultural and artistic value, and became a Sichuan Provincial Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit in 2007. Da'an Temple was first built in the late Eastern Han dynasty, originally named Yuantong Daoist Temple, built by Zhang Lu, the warlord dominating Hanzhong and the Celestial Master of the Five Pecks of Rice Dao. In early Tang it was rebuilt by Yuchi Jingde and renamed Yuantong Temple. During the Ming Chongzhen era, because the abbot of Yuantong Temple led his disciples to resist Zhang Xianzhong's army, protecting the temple and the peace of the surrounding area, it was renamed Da'an (Great Peace) Temple. The outer perimeter of Da'an Temple has been repaired and whitewashed, restoring its former grand appearance; with the verdant trees and forests, it appears serene and solemn. Unfortunately, the inside of the temple seems not to have been maintained for many years, appearing dilapidated, in stark contrast to the outer walls. Inside the hall there is a Republican-era stone stele recording the donation for the temple's reconstruction. In addition, there is an iron stele, said to weigh a thousand jin, the town-protecting treasure of Da'an Temple. The iron stele was cast in Ming dynasty; on the stele is engraved the inscription Record of the Establishment of Guanyin Temple, recording the maintenance of Yuantong Temple. Although covered in rust all over, it is well preserved, and the inscription is still clearly visible. Looking around, the desolate temple courtyard appears old and desolate; broken bricks and tiles are casually piled on the beams. Although the Buddha statues inside the hall are still solemn, they cannot withstand the ravages of time, covered in dust, extremely cold and lonely.

projects.name: 广元千佛崖摩崖造像
projects.name_en: Cliffside Statues of Qianfo Cliff in Guangyuan
projects.address: 广元城北嘉陵江东岸
projects.content_zh: 广元千佛崖是与皇泽寺齐名的一处文化圣地，坐落于广元城北的嘉陵江东岸。崖上保存着数百米长的石窟群，宏伟的规模冠绝四川地区。虽由于1935年修建川陕公路，使得造像损毁过半以上，但崖上现今仍存在造像7000余尊，龛窟1192个，题刻118条，可想当年千佛崖规模何其壮观。1961年，千佛崖摩崖造像当之无愧地被国务院列为首批全国重点文物保护单位。造像始雕刻于北魏晚期，在唐代和五代时期兴盛异常。历经千年岁月的更迭，峭壁上重龛窟满布，并分为南北两段，以规模最大的大云洞为中心。千佛崖上最早开凿的洞窟为大佛窟，始凿于北魏时期。龛中现存一尊佛与两尊菩萨三尊大像，其衣饰飘逸，面相庄严，为典型的南北朝的风格，可惜的是这些造像曾经受到了不同程度的破坏，多不完整。此外，莲花洞窟龛造像为唐代雕刻艺术的珍品，开凿于武则天称帝时期。莲花洞因洞顶的莲花而得名，洞前介绍上说，洞内雕刻着三世佛造像，分别为阿弥陀佛、释迦佛和弥勒佛，弥勒佛居中，神态庄严安详，面容栩栩如生。据说，武则天称帝时，有白马寺12名和尚撰写《大云经》对其歌功颂德，称之为弥勒佛转世，取李唐而代之实为天命。武皇非常高兴，便下令全国兴建大云寺，普及《大云经》。从千佛崖前的大云寺，规模最大的大云洞龛窟，及大云洞正中的弥勒佛大佛像便可见一斑。千佛崖石窟规模宏大，造像精美，历史悠久，临江而建气势非凡，是四川省内必去的旅游景点之一。
projects.content_en: Qianfo (Thousand-Buddha) Cliff in Guangyuan is a cultural sacred place on par with Huangze Temple, located on the east bank of the Jialing River north of Guangyuan city. On the cliff there are preserved grotto groups several hundred meters long, with a grand scale unmatched in Sichuan. Although due to the construction of the Sichuan-Shaanxi Highway in 1935, over half of the statues were damaged, today there still exist over 7,000 statues, 1,192 niches and caves, and 118 inscriptions on the cliff — one can imagine how spectacular the scale of Qianfo Cliff was in those days. In 1961, the Cliffside Statues of Qianfo Cliff were deservedly listed by the State Council as one of the first batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units. The statues were first carved in the late Northern Wei, and flourished extraordinarily in Tang and Five Dynasties periods. After a thousand years of changes, the steep cliff is densely covered with niches and caves, divided into north and south sections, centered on the largest-scale Dayun (Great Cloud) Cave. The earliest excavated cave on Qianfo Cliff is the Great Buddha Cave, first excavated in the Northern Wei period. In the niche there currently survive three large statues — one Buddha and two Bodhisattvas; their garments are elegant, their faces solemn, a typical Northern and Southern Dynasties style. Unfortunately these statues have suffered varying degrees of damage and are mostly incomplete. In addition, the statues in the Lotus Flower Cave niche are treasures of Tang dynasty carving art, excavated during the period when Wu Zetian proclaimed herself emperor. The Lotus Flower Cave is named after the lotus flower on the cave ceiling; according to the introduction in front of the cave, inside the cave are carved statues of the Buddhas of Three Ages, respectively Amitabha Buddha, Shakyamuni Buddha, and Maitreya Buddha; Maitreya Buddha is in the center, with a solemn and serene expression, and a lifelike face. It is said that when Wu Zetian proclaimed herself emperor, 12 monks from Baima Temple wrote the Great Cloud Sutra to sing her praises, calling her the reincarnation of Maitreya Buddha, and that replacing the Li Tang was indeed the Mandate of Heaven. Empress Wu was very pleased, and ordered the construction of Great Cloud Temples nationwide to popularize the Great Cloud Sutra. This can be seen from the Great Cloud Temple in front of Qianfo Cliff, the largest-scale Dayun Cave niche, and the large Maitreya Buddha statue in the center of Dayun Cave. The Qianfo Cliff grottoes have a grand scale, exquisite statues, and a long history; built facing the river with extraordinary momentum, they are one of the must-visit tourist attractions in Sichuan Province.

projects.name: 皇泽寺
projects.address: 广元市利州区嘉陵江西岸
projects.content_zh: 广元最负盛名的旅游景点之一应该就是皇泽寺了。这座供奉着女皇武则天的祀庙，恢宏壮阔，气宇轩昂。皇泽寺是全国唯一的一座武则天祀庙，且寺内留存着从北魏至明清的摩崖造像、碑刻，具有浓厚的历史底蕴和珍贵的文化价值。于1961年成为了国务院批准的第一批全国重点文物保护单位。皇泽寺坐落于广元城西的嘉陵江西岸，隔江呼应着广元城区。寺庙始建于北魏，原为纪念李冰及其子二郎所建，名为乌奴寺，又名川主庙。后武则天称帝，为福泽故里广元（时名利州），出资粉饰川主庙，并取皇恩浩荡，泽及故里之意，将寺庙改名为皇泽寺。走进华丽庄严的皇泽寺，迎面便是供奉着武则天与唐高宗李治的二圣殿，大殿中央，武则天与李治的塑像庄严而坐，两边站立着高宗、武周时期的九位名臣。二圣殿后为皇泽寺主殿则天殿。则天殿为整个寺庙中心，殿中矗立着全国唯一的一座武则天真容石刻塑像，石像是由整块的砂岩雕饰琢磨而成，高约1.8米。只见女皇头戴法冠，身披法衣，手结法印，佛法庄严，慈悲之像可谓是巧夺天工。在皇泽寺的庙堂之中，还保存着另一千古奇珍，这便是皇泽寺的石刻造像。皇泽寺有着1203身分布于中心塔柱窟、大佛楼、则天殿等处的摩崖造像，50个窟龛。始开凿于北魏，经过北周、隋、唐、明、清等朝代的持续雕琢，终有今日之规模。则天殿之上的中心柱窟造像开凿于北魏晚期，是皇泽寺造像之中历史最为悠久的一处，可谓冠绝全蜀。中心柱为一根雕琢成经塔状的方柱，支撑起整个窟龛，窟中三面壁墙龛中均刻有佛像，温润质朴，肃穆庄严。皇泽寺最大的一龛造像则为初唐年代建成的大佛窟，龛内佛像众多，壁饰精美。主佛、弟子、观音等造像展现出各异的神态与肢体语言，形象生动，令人惊异于唐代造像的高超造诣。皇泽寺近年来经过全面整修，原有古建筑已经修整为典型的唐代风格，与皇泽寺主题以及历史相互映衬。
projects.content_en: One of Guangyuan's most famous tourist attractions should be Huangze Temple. This temple enshrining Empress Wu Zetian is grand and magnificent, with imposing dignity. Huangze Temple is the only Wu Zetian temple in the country, and inside the temple there are preserved cliffside statues and stele carvings from Northern Wei to Ming-Qing, with a strong historical heritage and precious cultural value. In 1961 it became one of the first batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units approved by the State Council. Huangze Temple is located on the west bank of the Jialing River, west of Guangyuan city, echoing the Guangyuan urban area across the river. The temple was first built in Northern Wei, originally built to commemorate Li Bing and his son Erlang, named Wunu Temple, also known as Chuanzhu (Sichuan Master) Temple. Later, when Wu Zetian proclaimed herself emperor, to bless her hometown Guangyuan (then called Lizhou), she funded the whitewashing of Chuanzhu Temple, and taking the meaning of imperial grace vast and benefiting the hometown, renamed the temple Huangze (Imperial Grace) Temple. Walking into the gorgeous and solemn Huangze Temple, facing you is the Two Sages Hall enshrining Wu Zetian and Emperor Gaozong Li Zhi of Tang; in the center of the hall, the statues of Wu Zetian and Li Zhi sit solemnly, and on both sides stand nine famous ministers of the Gaozong and Wu Zhou periods. Behind the Two Sages Hall is the main hall of Huangze Temple, the Zetian Hall. The Zetian Hall is the center of the entire temple; in the hall stands the only stone-carved statue of Wu Zetian's true appearance in the country; the stone statue is carved and polished from a whole block of sandstone, about 1.8m high. The empress wears a ceremonial crown, a ceremonial robe, and forms a mudra with her hands; the Dharma is solemn, and the compassionate appearance can be said to be a marvel of craftsmanship. In the halls of Huangze Temple, another eternal treasure is preserved — the stone-carved statues of Huangze Temple. Huangze Temple has 1,203 cliffside statues distributed in the Central Pillar Cave, Great Buddha Tower, Zetian Hall, etc., and 50 caves and niches. First excavated in Northern Wei, through continuous carving in Northern Zhou, Sui, Tang, Ming, Qing and other dynasties, it finally reached today's scale. The statues in the Central Pillar Cave above the Zetian Hall were excavated in the late Northern Wei, the oldest among Huangze Temple's statues, truly unmatched in all of Sichuan. The central pillar is a square pillar carved into a scripture-tower shape, supporting the entire cave niche; in the niches on the three wall surfaces of the cave there are carved Buddha statues, warm and simple, solemn and dignified. The largest niche of statues in Huangze Temple is the Great Buddha Cave built in the early Tang period; inside the niche there are numerous Buddha statues, with exquisite wall decorations. The statues of the main Buddha, disciples, Guanyin, etc. show various expressions and body language, vivid in image, making one marvel at the superb attainment of Tang dynasty statue carving. In recent years Huangze Temple has undergone comprehensive renovation; the original ancient buildings have been restored to a typical Tang dynasty style, complementing the theme and history of Huangze Temple.

projects.name: 昭化古城
projects.address: 广元市苍溪县嘉陵江西畔
projects.highlights: 三国文化、石坊、城墙、城门
projects.content_zh: 昭化古城位于广元市昭化区昭化镇，距离广元市区较远。昭化古城古名葭萌，即《三国演义》中张飞与马超大战一天一夜的战场，也是中国唯一一处保存完整的三国古城。古城是剑门蜀道遗址群的重要组成部分，而剑门蜀道遗址群于2006年被国务院列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位。昭化古城位于连接巴蜀和中原的剑门蜀道之上，历来便是蜀地军事要冲。进入景区，沿桔柏渡街行走便可看到一座书写着葭萌二字的牌坊，上刻楹联天下第一太极；蜀道三国重镇，巍峨高大，古韵十足。昭化古城有东西南北四个城门，分别名为瞻凤临清临江拱极。古城门建于明朝正德年间，除南门因防洪于清代被封闭以外，东、西、北门皆保存得较为完好，现皆为省级文化保护单位。古城之内的遗址丰富，留存有县衙、考棚、文庙等建筑，较为完好地记录了古人在城内的生活形式。此外，古城周边还有丰富的三国历史遗迹，如牛头山、姜维井、战胜坝等，见证了三国蜀汉政权的兴亡。
projects.content_en: Zhaohua Ancient City is located in Zhaohua Town, Zhaohua District, Guangyuan City, relatively far from the Guangyuan urban area. Zhaohua Ancient City was anciently called Jiameng, the battlefield where Zhang Fei and Ma Chao fought for a day and a night in Romance of the Three Kingdoms, and is also the only completely preserved Three Kingdoms ancient city in China. The ancient city is an important component of the Jianmen Shu Road site group, and the Jianmen Shu Road site group was listed by the State Council as the 6th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units in 2006. Zhaohua Ancient City is located on the Jianmen Shu Road connecting Bashu (Sichuan) with the Central Plains, and has historically been a military strategic point in Shu. Entering the scenic area, walking along Jubaidu Street, one can see an archway with the two characters Jiameng written on it; on it are carved the couplet The First Taiji Under Heaven; A Three Kingdoms Strategic Town on the Shu Road — towering and tall, full of ancient charm. Zhaohua Ancient City has four city gates in the east, west, south, and north, respectively named Zhanfeng, Linqing, Linjiang, and Gongji. The ancient city gates were built during the Ming Zhengde era; except for the south gate which was closed in Qing for flood control, the east, west, and north gates are all relatively well preserved, and are now all provincial cultural protection units. The sites inside the ancient city are rich, with surviving buildings such as the county yamen, examination shed, and Confucian temple, relatively completely recording the lifestyle of ancient people in the city. In addition, around the ancient city there are also rich Three Kingdoms historical relics, such as Niutou Mountain, Jiang Wei Well, and Zhansheng Dam, witnessing the rise and fall of the Shu Han regime of the Three Kingdoms.

projects.name: 剑溪桥
projects.address: 广元市剑阁县剑门关外
projects.highlights: 四川北部唯一的明石拱桥、结构
projects.content_zh: 从剑门关向外找寻，不过两公里左右，便可寻觅坐落于大剑溪上的剑溪桥。剑溪桥是四川省第八批重点文物保护单位，也是四川北部现存的唯一一座明代石拱桥。桥的对面是志公寺，漫步古桥，潺潺江水与婆娑的树影相伴，越发显得清幽静谧。桥旁有省保碑与介绍牌，据介绍牌所述，这座明代的石拱桥建于明弘治年间，长18.8米，宽4米，高7米，为剑门蜀道上极其重要的古桥梁。桥有三孔，皆为两半拱圈拼合而成。桥面由板石铺就而成，历经数百年依旧稳固如初。桥头雕有石狮，精致而富有生趣。支撑着桥的四个桥墩坚固厚实地屹立江中，侧面铺筑的青砖颜色因岁月流逝而斑驳陆离，沧桑而不失凝重。据说，剑门山区时有山洪暴涨，水却从未漫过桥面，当地人因此敬畏此桥，认为桥在修建时藏有法术，以保卫剑阁这一方净土。可见，这幽静深沉的剑溪桥，不仅方便着人们的交通往来，也默默承载着这沧桑的历史与人文情怀。
projects.content_en: Searching outward from Jianmen Pass, only about two kilometers away, one can find Jianxi Bridge located on the Dajian Stream. Jianxi Bridge is the 8th batch of key cultural relic protection units in Sichuan Province, and is also the only surviving Ming dynasty stone arch bridge in northern Sichuan. Opposite the bridge is Zhigong Temple; strolling on the ancient bridge, the gurgling river water is accompanied by the dancing shadows of trees, making it even more serene and quiet. Beside the bridge there is a provincial protection stele and an introduction sign; according to the introduction sign, this Ming dynasty stone arch bridge was built during the Ming Hongzhi era, 18.8m long, 4m wide, and 7m high — an extremely important ancient bridge on the Jianmen Shu Road. The bridge has three arches, all formed by the joining of two half-arch rings. The bridge deck is paved with slab stones, and after hundreds of years is still as stable as when first built. At the bridgehead there are carved stone lions, exquisite and full of vitality. The four bridge piers supporting the bridge stand firmly and solidly in the river; the grey bricks paved on the sides are mottled due to the passage of time, weathered yet without losing their gravity. It is said that in the Jianmen mountain area flash floods sometimes surge, but the water has never overflowed the bridge deck; local people therefore revere this bridge, believing that when the bridge was built, magic was hidden in it to protect this pure land of Jiange. It can be seen that this serene and deep Jianxi Bridge not only facilitates people's transportation and exchanges, but also silently carries this weathered history and humanistic sentiment.

projects.name: 剑门蜀道
projects.address: 广元市剑阁县
projects.content_zh: 剑门蜀道，南起绵阳市演武镇，北至广元市朝天镇。整段蜀道环绕古城剑阁约200公里，在沟通蜀地与外界的交通上起到了非凡的作用。蜀道修建工程始于西周，其后一直默默造福着蜀地人民，直至民国时期仍在使用。现剑门蜀道处于剑门蜀道风景名胜区内，是国务院批准的首批国家级风景名胜区之一。在剑门关最初设计之时，考虑到蜀地险峻，易守难攻，因而蜀地工匠依照山势，建造出了这一防守型的军事要塞。由于此处为蜀地咽喉，历来是兵家必争之地，因而时至今日，峡谷关口上仍留存有丰富的军事相关的历史遗迹。以剑门关楼为例，作为军事防守的要塞，雄踞蜀道之上，坚韧挺拔，关楼上布置有箭楼，高达三层，飞檐翘角上装饰有精美的雕塑，关楼之上旌旗卷舒，猎猎作响，使人回想昔时一夫当关万夫莫开的战时情景。蜀地自古物华天宝，人杰地灵，从不乏古迹名胜、福地洞天，这其中更是有四绝——剑门之险、九寨之奇、青城之幽、峨眉之秀。置身于剑门关隘，只觉崇山峻岭、气势磅礴，借用昔日范仲淹句：则有心旷神怡，宠辱偕忘，把酒临风，其喜洋洋者矣。
projects.content_en: The Jianmen Shu Road starts from Yanwu Town, Mianyang City in the south, and reaches Chaotian Town, Guangyuan City in the north. The entire section of the Shu Road encircles the ancient city of Jiange for about 200 km, and played an extraordinary role in communicating transportation between Shu and the outside world. The construction project of the Shu Road began in Western Zhou, and thereafter silently benefited the people of Shu, still in use until the Republican period. Currently the Jianmen Shu Road is within the Jianmen Shu Road Scenic Area, one of the first batch of national-level scenic areas approved by the State Council. When Jianmen Pass was first designed, considering the steepness of Shu, easy to defend and hard to attack, Shu craftsmen built this defensive military fortress according to the mountain terrain. Because this place is the throat of Shu, it has historically been a contested military point; hence to this day, rich military-related historical relics still remain at the canyon pass. Taking the Jianmen Pass Tower as an example, as a military defensive fortress, it dominates the Shu Road, tough and upright; on the pass tower there are arranged arrow towers, up to three stories high, with exquisite sculptures decorating the flying eaves and upturned corners; above the pass tower banners flutter and rustle, making one recall the wartime scene of one man guarding the pass and ten thousand unable to pass in old times. Since ancient times Shu has been a land of natural treasures and outstanding people, never lacking in historic sites and famous scenic spots, blessed caves and heavens — among them there are even four wonders — the danger of Jianmen, the wonder of Jiuzhai, the seclusion of Qingcheng, and the elegance of Emei. Being in the Jianmen Pass, one only feels the lofty mountains and majestic momentum; borrowing the words of Fan Zhongyan of old: then one feels carefree and joyful, forgetting both favor and disgrace, holding wine to the wind, filled with delight.

projects.name: 钟鼓楼建筑区
projects.name_en: Bell Tower, Drum Tower and Surrounding Ancient Buildings
projects.address: 广元市剑阁县普安镇
projects.content_zh: 钟鼓楼建筑区位于广元市剑阁县普安镇，始于明代正德年间，由剑州知州李璧主持修建，在明末由于战乱被毁，现在所见到的钟鼓楼古建筑是民国时期原址上重建的。钟鼓楼古建筑区在1991年被四川省政府列为省级重点文物保护单位。钟鼓楼建筑区包括南城门、钟鼓楼、火神庙以及南门的明代城墙。据相关资料记载，南城门门高3.5米，宽3.4米，门上有箭楼，高8米，城门处的木门仍然保存完好，两侧石柱上雕有野鹿衔花与吉祥如意的图纹，门洞上方题有秀分阆苑四字。钟鼓楼坐北朝南，整栋楼由木、石柱支撑，分为3层，屋内铺筒瓦，各层均有花草雕饰。火神庙位于钟鼓楼北侧，庙两侧有配殿。南门的明代城墙外侧由石条修砌，墙心用土夯实，总长约500米，这些城墙距今已有将近500年的历史，现在仍然保存完好。现在钟鼓楼周围居民底层均开有店铺，古老的建筑区与现代城市的气息交相辉映。
projects.content_en: The Bell Tower, Drum Tower and Surrounding Ancient Buildings area is located in Pu'an Town, Jiange County, Guangyuan City. It began in the Ming Zhengde era, presided over and built by Li Bi, the prefect of Jianzhou; it was destroyed at the end of Ming due to war, and the ancient bell and drum tower buildings seen today were rebuilt on the original site during the Republican period. The ancient building area of the bell and drum tower was listed as a provincial key cultural relic protection unit by the Sichuan Provincial Government in 1991. The building area includes the South City Gate, Bell and Drum Tower, Fire God Temple, and the Ming dynasty city wall of the South Gate. According to relevant records, the South City Gate is 3.5m high and 3.4m wide; above the gate there is an arrow tower, 8m high; the wooden door at the city gate is still well preserved; on the stone pillars on both sides there are carved patterns of wild deer holding flowers and auspiciousness; above the gate opening there is an inscription of the four characters Xiu Fen Lang Yuan. The Bell and Drum Tower faces south; the entire building is supported by wooden and stone pillars, divided into 3 stories; inside the house there are tubular tiles, and each story has flower and plant carvings. The Fire God Temple is located on the north side of the Bell and Drum Tower, with side halls on both sides of the temple. The outer side of the Ming dynasty city wall at the South Gate is built with stone strips, and the wall core is rammed with earth, with a total length of about 500m; these city walls have a history of nearly 500 years, and are still well preserved today. Now around the Bell and Drum Tower, residents have opened shops on the ground floor, and the ancient building area echoes with the atmosphere of the modern city.

projects.name: 鹤鸣山道教石窟石刻
projects.name_en: Taoist Grottoes and Stone Sculptures at Mount Heming
projects.address: 广元剑阁县普安镇鹤鸣山
projects.content_zh: 鹤鸣山道教石窟及石刻位于广元剑阁县普安镇城东的鹤鸣山。鹤鸣山是中国道教四大名山之一，山上保存着自东汉以来建造的道教石窟石刻以及始于北魏的道教造像。由于丰富的历史内涵与精美的石刻造像艺术，鹤鸣山道教石窟石刻由国务院列为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。我们所到的时间为下午五时左右，守门的老大爷本已关门，但见我们从北京不远千里而来，向我们行了个方便，使我们有幸能够在静谧的山野之中瞻仰这片珍贵的历史遗存。进门迎首便能看见一尊仪态超凡的老君塑像，彰显着道教的文化底蕴。顺着廊道向内，依次可以看到鹤鸣山石刻中的唐代三绝：李商隐的《剑州重阳亭铭》碑，颜真卿的《大唐中兴颂》以及重阳亭中的道教石刻造像。这些出于唐代的石刻与造像，自有唐代的风骨与大气。李商隐所撰《剑州重阳亭铭》以小篆为书写字体，笔力遒劲；颜真卿所书《大唐中兴颂》，笔力丰满，大气磅礴，无怪乎世人赞誉颜筋柳骨；造像现存有五个龛窟，可惜其中的造像多有被盗，剩余的几尊主像如一号龛的长生大帝，与三号龛的长生保命天尊，皆面容丰腴而仪态庄严，线条流畅飘逸，为唐代造像之中的珍品。
projects.content_en: The Taoist Grottoes and Stone Sculptures at Mount Heming are located on Mount Heming, east of Pu'an Town, Jiange County, Guangyuan. Mount Heming is one of the four famous Taoist mountains in China; on the mountain there are preserved Taoist grotto stone carvings built since the Eastern Han dynasty and Taoist statues beginning in the Northern Wei. Due to its rich historical connotation and exquisite stone carving statue art, the Taoist Grottoes and Stone Sculptures at Mount Heming were listed by the State Council as the 7th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units. The time we arrived was around five in the afternoon; the old gatekeeper had already closed the door, but seeing that we had come all the way from Beijing, he did us a favor, allowing us the honor of viewing this precious historical relic in the quiet mountain wilderness. Upon entering, one can immediately see a statue of Lord Lao Zi with extraordinary bearing, manifesting the cultural heritage of Taoism. Following the corridor inward, one can sequentially see the Three Wonders of Tang in the Heming Mountain stone carvings: the Stele of Inscription on the Chongyang Pavilion of Jianzhou by Li Shangyin, the Ode to the Resurgence of the Great Tang by Yan Zhenqing, and the Taoist stone-carved statues in the Chongyang Pavilion. These stone carvings and statues from Tang dynasty naturally have the character and grandeur of Tang. The Inscription on the Chongyang Pavilion of Jianzhou written by Li Shangyin uses small seal script as the writing font, with powerful brushstrokes; the Ode to the Resurgence of the Great Tang written by Yan Zhenqing has full and powerful brushstrokes, grand and majestic — no wonder the world praises Yan's muscles and Liu's bones. There are currently five niches and caves of statues; unfortunately many of the statues inside have been stolen; the remaining few main statues, such as the Longevity Great Emperor in Niche No. 1 and the Longevity-Preserving Heavenly Venerable in Niche No. 3, all have plump faces and solemn bearing, with smooth and elegant lines — treasures among Tang dynasty statues.

projects.name: 觉苑寺
projects.address: 广元市剑阁县武连镇
projects.content_zh: 觉苑寺位于广元剑阁县武连镇，寺庙始建于唐代，据说是一代名臣魏征的家庙，后经历代重修重建，现存为明代风格建筑。觉苑寺内的佛传壁画精美瑰丽，享负盛名。觉苑寺在2001年被国务院确立为第五批全国重点文物保护单位。觉苑寺由三座大殿及东西对称的两座配殿所组成。其中三座大殿依次为天王殿、大雄宝殿以及观音殿。大雄宝殿为明代所建，殿内两根立柱上各雕塑着巨龙盘踞其上，气势恢宏。殿内供有三尊如来佛像，寓意为佛家佛、法、僧一体三宝。三尊佛像造型一致，唯手势不一。中间象征着佛的造像双手合十，说法入定，神态安详而慈悲。侍立在如来造像左右的为阿楠、迦叶两位尊者。佛龛后还有一尊阿弥陀佛的立像，神态端庄威严。在大雄宝殿的内壁上，留存着200多幅精致珍贵的《佛传》故事壁画。在传说中，这些壁画是在唐代建庙时，由画圣吴道子一夜之间绘制完成。虽只是传说，但也反映了觉苑寺壁画的绘画精美，艺术高超。壁画故事内容广博而生动，且皆书有四字标题。据说是由于壁画绘就之时采用了特殊的技法，虽已经数百年岁月的流逝，这些壁画却仍旧绚烂多彩，令人叫绝。
projects.content_en: Jueyuan Temple is located in Wulian Town, Jiange County, Guangyuan. The temple was first built in Tang dynasty, said to be the family temple of the famous minister Wei Zheng, later rebuilt and reconstructed through the dynasties; the existing buildings are in Ming dynasty style. The Buddha-life murals inside Jueyuan Temple are exquisite and magnificent, enjoying a great reputation. Jueyuan Temple was established by the State Council as the 5th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units in 2001. Jueyuan Temple consists of three main halls and two symmetric side halls on the east and west. Among them, the three main halls are sequentially the Heavenly Kings Hall, Mahavira Hall, and Guanyin Hall. The Mahavira Hall was built in Ming dynasty; on the two columns inside the hall there are each sculpted giant dragons coiling upon them, with grand momentum. Inside the hall there are enshrined three Tathagata Buddha statues, symbolizing the Three Treasures of Buddhism — Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha as one. The three Buddha statues have the same form, only differing in hand gestures. The statue in the center symbolizing the Buddha has hands joined in prayer, preaching and entering meditation, with a serene and compassionate expression. Attending on the left and right of the Tathagata statue are the two venerable Ananda and Mahakasyapa. Behind the Buddhist niche there is also a standing statue of Amitabha Buddha, with a dignified and majestic bearing. On the inner walls of the Mahavira Hall, there are preserved over 200 exquisite and precious murals of the Buddha-life story. According to legend, these murals were painted overnight by the Painting Sage Wu Daozi when the temple was built in Tang. Although only a legend, it also reflects the exquisite painting and superb artistry of the Jueyuan Temple murals. The mural story content is broad and vivid, and all are inscribed with four-character titles. It is said that because special techniques were used when the murals were painted, although hundreds of years have passed, these murals are still brilliant and colorful, amazing to behold.

projects.name: 临江寺
projects.address: 广元市苍溪县嘉陵江西畔
projects.content_zh: 临江寺位于苍溪县城城西的嘉陵江西畔，古朴沧桑的寺庙因靠临江古渡而获名。临江寺一带人烟较为稀少，寺庙里面也鲜有人踏足，远离尘世的喧嚣的临江古寺显得幽深而静谧。寺庙始建于乾隆二十六年(1771年)，经过道光、同治年间的扩建，已成现有规模。2006年临江寺被四川省人民政府正式确认为省级文物保护单位。临江寺的格局依山傍水，兼有两只石狮守于寺前，气势很是恢宏壮阔。拾级而上，可见寺中矗立着一座送客亭，碑上所刻铭文为唐杜少陵送客至此。杜甫当年旅居阆中期间，曾送客至临江渡，客人的名字现今不可考，却有一首杜甫诗文传世。这便是《送客至苍溪放船归阆》：送客苍溪县，山寒雨不开。直愁骑马滑，故作放船回。青惜峰峦过，黄知橘柚来。江流大自在，稳坐兴悠哉。杜甫一生坎坷，却在临江古渡的嘉陵江这大自在江流中，感觉到少有的兴悠哉，这也是临江渡和杜少陵的缘分吧。送客亭也因其独有的人文情怀，被后人所瞻仰铭记。除历史人文情怀以外，临江寺独有的特色便是所有的佛像皆在石洞之中，石洞沿山势而凿，殿、楼、廊、径依峭壁而设。寺庙在峭壁之上，与山势配合巧妙，不得不令人佩服古人高超的建筑智慧。漫步古寺之内，古朴沧桑的建筑令人流连，石凿的古寺所承载的浓厚历史底蕴也令人神往。
projects.content_en: Linjiang Temple is located on the west bank of the Jialing River, west of Cangxi County town. The simple and weathered temple got its name because it relies on the ancient Linjiang Ferry. The area around Linjiang Temple is relatively sparsely populated, and few people set foot inside the temple; the ancient Linjiang Temple, far from the hustle and bustle of the world, appears deep and quiet. The temple was first built in the 26th year of Qianlong (1771), and after expansion during the Daoguang and Tongzhi eras, it reached its current scale. In 2006 Linjiang Temple was officially confirmed as a provincial cultural relic protection unit by the Sichuan Provincial People's Government. The layout of Linjiang Temple is against the mountain and beside the water, with two stone lions guarding in front of the temple, with a grand and magnificent momentum. Ascending the steps, one can see a Send-off Pavilion standing in the temple; the inscription carved on the stele reads Tang Du Shaoling sent guests here. During Du Fu's stay in Langzhong, he once saw guests off to the Linjiang Ferry; the guest's name is now unverifiable, but a poem by Du Fu has been handed down. This is Seeing Guests Off to Cangxi and Returning by Boat to Lang: Seeing guests off at Cangxi County, the mountain is cold and rain does not clear. Only worrying about slipping on horseback, so I return by boat. Green regrets the peaks passing by, yellow knows the oranges and pomelos coming. The great river flows in great freedom, sitting steadily with leisurely delight. Du Fu had a rough life, but in the great free-flowing Jialing River at the ancient Linjiang Ferry, he felt a rare leisurely delight — this is also the fate between Linjiang Ferry and Du Shaoling. The Send-off Pavilion, due to its unique humanistic sentiment, has been admired and remembered by later generations. Besides historical and humanistic sentiment, the unique feature of Linjiang Temple is that all the Buddha statues are in stone caves; the stone caves are chiseled along the mountain terrain, and halls, towers, corridors, and paths are set according to the steep cliff. The temple is on the steep cliff, cleverly coordinated with the mountain terrain, making one不得不 admire the superb architectural wisdom of the ancients. Strolling inside the ancient temple, the simple and weathered buildings make one linger; the rich historical heritage carried by the stone-carved ancient temple is also fascinating.

projects.name: 崇霞宝塔
projects.address: 广元苍溪县城东文焕村宝塔山
projects.content_zh: 崇霞宝塔位于广元苍溪县城东文焕村宝塔山，在绿树丛生的山顶一枝独秀。崇霞宝塔始建于天启六年(1626年)，即木匠皇帝朱由校在位年间。先后因年久失修及汶川地震而两次重建粉饰。作为4A级景区红军渡·西武当山风景区的三景之一，容貌一新的崇霞宝塔在苍溪享有盛名，并于2007年被列为四川省省级文化保护单位。前往崇霞宝塔的路比较漫长，塔前近乎接天的石阶也令人生畏。经过近百级石阶的攀登，我们已经大汗淋漓，不过看到眼前的宝塔还是令人震撼。崇霞宝塔是楼阁式砖塔，外檐逐层内缩，整体呈锥状，着实巍峨挺拔，塔尖直指苍穹，庄严肃穆。塔座和底层由石料修建，其余塔身每层皆由六棱形砖堆叠而成，工艺巧妙。塔身雪白，故当地人称之为白塔。塔内有环梯，顺梯而上，可以看到塔身各层皆开有壁窗。透过壁窗，凭借塔势，可以观赏宝塔山四周开阔的盛景。举目四望，苍山翠林，着实令人心旷神怡。
projects.content_en: Chongxia Pagoda is located on Baota (Pagoda) Mountain, Wenhuan Village, east of Cangxi County town, Guangyuan, standing out alone on the tree-covered mountain top. Chongxia Pagoda was first built in the 6th year of Tianqi (1626), during the reign of the Carpenter Emperor Zhu Youxiao. It was twice rebuilt and whitewashed due to long-term disrepair and the Wenchuan earthquake. As one of the three scenic spots of the 4A-level scenic area Hongjun Ferry · West Wudang Mountain Scenic Area, the refreshed Chongxia Pagoda enjoys great fame in Cangxi, and was listed as a Sichuan Provincial Cultural Protection Unit in 2007. The road to Chongxia Pagoda is relatively long, and the stone steps in front of the pagoda, almost reaching the sky, are also daunting. After climbing nearly a hundred stone steps, we were already sweating profusely, but seeing the pagoda before us was still shocking. Chongxia Pagoda is a pavilion-style brick pagoda; the outer eaves taper inward layer by layer, the whole is conical, truly towering and upright, with the pagoda tip pointing straight at the sky, solemn and dignified. The pagoda base and bottom layer are built of stone; the rest of the pagoda body, each layer, is stacked with hexagonal bricks, with ingenious craftsmanship. The pagoda body is snow-white, hence local people call it the White Pagoda. Inside the pagoda there is a circular staircase; ascending the staircase, one can see that each layer of the pagoda body has wall windows opened. Through the wall windows, by virtue of the pagoda's position, one can view the broad and magnificent scenery around Baota Mountain. Looking around, the green mountains and forests are truly refreshing and delightful.

projects.name: 无量宝塔
projects.address: 南充市高坪区嘉陵江畔鹤鸣山
projects.content_zh: 无量宝塔又名南充白塔，位于南充市高坪区鹤鸣山风景区，嘉陵江大桥东端。宝塔凭借山势，俯瞰嘉陵江水，气势恢宏，是南充市的重要历史与旅游景观。无量宝塔始建于北宋建隆年间(960—963年)，明崇祯十四年(1641年)修补，近年也有进一步维修。此塔为方形十三层楼阁式砖石塔，通高37.1米。塔基为条石砌筑，塔身为砖砌，每层均以砖叠涩挑出，形成檐口。塔身每层每面均饰为四柱三间格局，圆柱顶部施斗拱，各间均设有壁龛或窗口。塔身第一层四面设拱门，但仅有西门可供人出入，内部第一层至十层设有塔心室，第十一层至第十三层皆实心。游客可沿蹬道登至第四层，远眺南充市景。塔外表面主要以白色粉刷，柱、枋及斗拱全施土黄色染料，在阳光照耀下尤为鲜艳夺目。塔身内外仿照木结构，工艺细腻精湛。白塔虽然历经1000多年风雨和多次地震，至今只有75厘米角度的倾斜，基本保持了原样。有关专家认为南充白塔是具有唐塔风格的五代至宋初砖构建筑，年代在四川宋塔中最早，体量较大，为四川宋代第一塔，是研究唐塔向宋塔过渡的珍贵遗产。2006年，无量宝塔被国务院列为全国重点文物保护单位。
projects.content_en: Wuliang (Boundless) Pagoda, also known as Nanchong White Pagoda, is located in the Heming Mountain Scenic Area, Gaoping District, Nanchong City, at the east end of the Jialing River Bridge. Relying on the mountain terrain, the pagoda overlooks the Jialing River water, with grand momentum, and is an important historical and tourist landscape of Nanchong City. Wuliang Pagoda was first built during the Northern Song Jianlong era (960-963), repaired in the 14th year of Chongzhen (1641), Ming, and has undergone further maintenance in recent years. This pagoda is a square thirteen-story pavilion-style brick-stone pagoda, with a total height of 37.1m. The pagoda base is built of dressed stones, the pagoda body is brick-built, and each layer is projected out with corbelled bricks to form the eave opening. Each face of each layer of the pagoda body is decorated in a four-column three-bay pattern; at the top of the cylindrical columns there are bracket sets, and each bay is equipped with a wall niche or window. The first layer of the pagoda body has arched doors on all four sides, but only the west door is accessible; inside, from the first to the tenth layer there are pagoda chambers, and from the eleventh to the thirteenth layer they are all solid. Tourists can climb along the stairway to the fourth layer to overlook the Nanchong cityscape. The outer surface of the pagoda is mainly whitewashed; columns, lintels, and bracket sets are all applied with earth-yellow dye, particularly vivid and eye-catching under the sunlight. The inside and outside of the pagoda body imitate timber structure, with exquisite and meticulous craftsmanship. Although the White Pagoda has experienced over 1,000 years of wind and rain and multiple earthquakes, to this day it only has a 75cm tilt, basically maintaining its original appearance. Relevant experts believe that the Nanchong White Pagoda is a brick structure building from the Five Dynasties to early Song with Tang pagoda style; its age is the earliest among Song pagodas in Sichuan, and its volume is relatively large, making it the No. 1 Song pagoda in Sichuan, a precious heritage for studying the transition from Tang to Song pagodas. In 2006, Wuliang Pagoda was listed by the State Council as a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit.

projects.name: 大通梓潼庙
projects.address: 南充市嘉陵区大通镇梓潼庙村
projects.highlights: 多层木构、内院、穿斗结构
projects.content_zh: 梓潼庙位于四川省南充市嘉陵区大通镇梓潼庙村二社，是一座佛道合一的宗教建筑，同时供奉道家文昌君以及佛家观音的佛像。此庙兴建于清乾隆四十九年(1784年)，后代进行过多次维修，但原始结构保留较为完整，古朴之风令人侧目。梓潼庙建在一座小山丘之上，占地1205平方米，有建筑面积700平方米，主要由文昌殿、观音殿、佛殿以及左右两侧的厢房组成。文昌殿面阔三间12米，进深15米，抬梁穿斗混合式梁架，单檐悬山顶，内部采用减柱造。下金檩上有楷体墨书知南充县邑侯觉斋高先知顺庆府总宪大夫承等字样。观音殿位于寺庙中央，为三层楼阁式建筑，底层面阔三间9米，进深8米，通高12.15米。楼内各层有梯道相连，重檐歇山顶，屋面铺小青瓦，檐角高翘。佛殿规模最大，面阔三间16米，进深13.4米，穿斗式结构，歇山顶。梓潼庙虽仅有三殿，但殿宇之间布局紧凑，起伏强烈，营造出极为丰富的建筑形态。虽经近200年风雨，木结构仍保存完好，充分展现了川东北民间建筑传统的活力与丰富性，非常值得寻古探幽的人们前往游览。
projects.content_en: Zitong Shrine is located in Zitongmiao Village, Datong Town, Jialing District, Nanchong City, Sichuan Province. It is a religious building integrating Buddhism and Daoism, simultaneously enshrining the Daoist Wenchang Lord and the Buddhist Guanyin statue. This shrine was built in the 49th year of Qianlong (1784), Qing, and has undergone multiple repairs in later generations, but the original structure is relatively completely preserved, with an ancient style that catches the eye. Zitong Shrine is built on a small hill, covering 1,205 sq m, with a building area of 700 sq m, mainly composed of the Wenchang Hall, Guanyin Hall, Buddha Hall, and wing rooms on the left and right sides. The Wenchang Hall is 3 bays wide (12m) and 15m deep, with a mixed post-and-lintel and chuan-dou beam frame, single-eave overhanging gable roof, and internally adopts column-reduction construction. On the lower gold purlin there are regular-script ink inscriptions such as Knowing Nanchong County Magistrate Juezhai Gao, Knowing Shunqing Prefecture Chief Official Cheng, etc. The Guanyin Hall is located in the center of the temple, a three-story pavilion-style building; the bottom layer is 3 bays wide (9m), 8m deep, with a total height of 12.15m. Inside the building, each layer is connected by stairways, with a double-eave xieshan roof, the roof surface paved with small grey tiles, and the eave corners high and upturned. The Buddha Hall is the largest in scale, 3 bays wide (16m), 13.4m deep, with a chuan-dou structure and xieshan roof. Although Zitong Shrine has only three halls, the layout between the halls is compact, with strong undulations, creating an extremely rich architectural form. Although having experienced nearly 200 years of wind and rain, the timber structure is still well preserved, fully demonstrating the vitality and richness of folk architectural traditions in northeastern Sichuan, very worthy of visit by people seeking ancient traces and exploring secluded places.

projects.name: 五台山石塔
projects.address: 阆中市保宁镇沙溪街道滕王阁村
projects.content_zh: 五台山石塔又名滕王亭子石塔，位于阆中市保宁镇北的五台山山腰，是全国重点文物保护单位。此塔始建于唐初，系唐高祖李渊第22子滕王李元婴被贬作隆州刺史迁阆中时，游玩此地建亭纪念而得名。五台山石塔所在地现在已经是一个景点，叫滕王阁风景区，周边景致优美。五台山石塔为覆钵式喇嘛塔，整个石塔坐北向南，通高8.6米，分为塔基、塔身和塔刹三个部分。塔基为方形，其上建四瓣梅花状须弥座。塔身以巨石雕刻而成，呈覆钵状，上大下小，正中向南辟由一龛，内塑佛像坐一尊，但面部风化严重。塔刹基座是圆形莲盘，其上雕刻有石雕八力士承托刹身，刹身为六角柱形，向上收分，各面均刻有佛像，最顶部是火焰宝珠。五台山石塔的人物造型、装饰及塔身造型带有明显的唐代特征，是研究佛塔式石构建筑的重要资料。2006年五台山石塔被列为全国重点文物保护单位。在汶川5·12地震中，塔巅坠地，2011年经专家修复，新建木亭保护古塔。
projects.content_en: The Stone Pagoda at Yutai Mountain, also known as the Stone Pagoda of Prince Teng's Pavilion, is located on the mountainside of Yutai Mountain, north of Baoning Town, Langzhong City, and is a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit. This pagoda was first built in the early Tang; it got its name when Li Yuanying, Prince Teng, the 22nd son of Tang Gaozu Li Yuan, was demoted to be the prefect of Longzhou and moved to Langzhong, and visited this place to build a pavilion for commemoration. The place where the Stone Pagoda at Yutai Mountain is located is now already a scenic spot, called the Tengwang Pavilion Scenic Area, with beautiful surrounding scenery. The Stone Pagoda at Yutai Mountain is an overturned-bowl-style Lama pagoda; the entire stone pagoda faces south, with a total height of 8.6m, divided into three parts: pagoda base, pagoda body, and pagoda finial. The pagoda base is square, on which a four-petal plum-blossom-shaped xumi seat is built. The pagoda body is carved from a giant stone, in an overturned-bowl shape, large at the top and small at the bottom; in the center facing south there is a niche opened, inside which a seated Buddha statue is molded, but the face is severely weathered. The base of the pagoda finial is a circular lotus disk, on which are carved eight stone-carved strongmen supporting the finial body; the finial body is hexagonal-column-shaped, tapering upward, with Buddha statues carved on each face, and at the very top is a flame jewel. The figure modeling, decoration, and pagoda body shape of the Stone Pagoda at Yutai Mountain have obvious Tang dynasty characteristics, and are important materials for studying Buddha-pagoda-style stone structure architecture. In 2006 the Stone Pagoda at Yutai Mountain was listed as a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit. In the Wenchuan 5·12 earthquake, the top of the pagoda fell to the ground; in 2011 it was restored by experts, and a new wooden pavilion was built to protect the ancient pagoda.

projects.name: 巴巴寺
projects.address: 南充市阆中市保宁镇
projects.content_zh: 巴巴寺始建于清康熙三十二年(1693年)，后经维修，是一组传统伊斯兰教宗教建筑，占地2.18万平方米，总建筑面积1520平方米。巴巴是阿拉伯语祖先的译音简化，此地是伊斯兰教嘎德忍耶教派第一位来我国传教的祖师华哲·阿卜董拉希(又称西来上人)的墓地，因此是我国伊斯兰教重要圣地；每年吸引来自陕西、甘肃、宁夏、四川等地穆斯林前来朝圣。巴巴寺位于南充市阆中市保宁镇，寺庙坐北朝南，由前门、照壁、牌坊、墓殿、井亭与园林等部分组成。巴巴寺的前门系木石结构牌坊式建筑。照壁及内围墙由砖建造，有仿木作斗拱。牌坊四柱三间三楼，木结构，檐下施如意斗拱。寺中最为重要的是墓殿，也是阿卜董拉希拱北(墓祠)所在地。大殿平面呈回字形，面阔、进深各三间11.7米，抬梁式结构，局部采用抹角梁做法，屋顶为三重檐盔式顶，屋面施灰筒瓦，檐下施斗拱。殿内外均有精美浮雕装饰，伊斯兰风格浓郁。墓殿东侧为花厅，是一处四合院小花园，遍植名花，景致宜人。寺庙周边空地也被用作教徒墓地，丧葬习俗遵循伊斯兰教传统。巴巴寺规模宏大，建筑造型独特，结合了汉地传统建筑与伊斯兰建筑特征，具有极高的文物价值。作为中国伊斯兰教圣地之一，至今仍发挥着重要的宗教作用。
projects.content_en: Baba Mosque was first built in the 32nd year of Kangxi (1693), Qing, and later underwent maintenance. It is a group of traditional Islamic religious buildings, covering 21,800 sq m, with a total building area of 1,520 sq m. Baba is the transliteration simplification of the Arabic word for ancestor; this place is the tomb of Huajie Abdong Laxi (also called the West-Coming Venerable), the first patriarch of the Islamic Qadiriyya sect who came to China to preach, hence it is an important Islamic holy land in China; every year it attracts Muslims from Shaanxi, Gansu, Ningxia, Sichuan and other places to come on pilgrimage. Baba Mosque is located in Baoning Town, Langzhong City, Nanchong City; the temple faces south, composed of the front gate, screen wall, archway, tomb hall, well pavilion, and garden, etc. The front gate of Baba Mosque is a timber-stone structure archway-style building. The screen wall and inner enclosure wall are built of brick, with imitation-timber bracket sets. The archway has four columns, three bays, and three stories, of timber structure, with ruyi bracket sets under the eaves. The most important in the temple is the tomb hall, also the location of Abdong Laxi's gongbei (tomb shrine). The main hall has a hui (回)-shaped plan, 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep (11.7m each), with a post-and-lintel structure, locally adopting beveled beam construction; the roof is a triple-eave helmet-style roof, the roof surface is applied with grey tubular tiles, and bracket sets are applied under the eaves. Inside and outside the hall there are exquisite relief decorations, with a strong Islamic style. East of the tomb hall is the flower hall, a small siheyuan garden, planted with famous flowers everywhere, with pleasant scenery. The open space around the temple is also used as a believer cemetery, and funeral customs follow Islamic traditions. Baba Mosque has a grand scale and unique architectural form, combining Han traditional architecture with Islamic architectural features, with extremely high cultural relic value. As one of the Islamic holy lands in China, it still plays an important religious role to this day.

projects.name: 张桓侯祠
projects.address: 南充市阆中市区
projects.highlights: 三国历史、碑帖、张飞墓、古树
projects.content_zh: 张桓侯祠，也称汉桓侯祠，是纪念三国名将张飞的祠庙，俗称张飞庙。因张飞死后，追谥为桓侯，因而得名。张桓侯祠位于全国历史文化名城四川省阆中市古城区西街，1996年被列为第四批全国重点文物保护单位。张桓侯祠始建于唐代，历代均有维修，现存建筑为明清重修。建筑群坐北向南，四合院布局，占地10余亩，建筑面积约2500平方米，由山门、敌万楼、左右牌坊、大殿、后殿、墓亭等组成。张桓侯祠主体建筑均沿中轴线布局。山门建于明代，五开间，悬山顶，檐下施六铺作计心斗拱11朵，两侧各有长9米的琉璃照壁。跨过山门，立于眼前的是明代所建敌万楼，面阔进深均为三间10米，楼高10余米，抬梁式梁架，重檐歇山式屋顶，上覆琉璃瓦，极为华丽。穿过敌万楼后30多米的小广场，面阔五间、宽22米的大殿矗立在两米高的石砌台基之上，气势雄伟。大殿后有廊道与后殿，墓亭相连。墓亭前两根浮雕云龙石柱工艺精美，栩栩如生。亭内有《张桓侯神道碑》一通。亭后即为张飞墓，墓坐北向南，呈椭圆形，东西宽22米，南北长32米，封土堆高8米，冢上古木参天，幽古之情极盛。祠内还有众多的历代名人碑刻匾联，展现了三国历史文化的深厚积淀。作为川内最为重要的三国文化遗迹之一，张桓侯祠已经成为四川历史文化传统中具有重要意义的一环。
projects.content_en: Zhang Huanhou's Shrine, also called Han Huanhou Shrine, is a shrine commemorating Zhang Fei, a famous general of the Three Kingdoms, commonly known as Zhang Fei Temple. Because after Zhang Fei's death, he was posthumously honored as Huanhou, hence the name. Zhang Huanhou's Shrine is located on West Street, the ancient city area of Langzhong City, Sichuan Province, a national historical and cultural city, and was listed as the 4th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units in 1996. Zhang Huanhou's Shrine was first built in Tang dynasty, with maintenance in all dynasties; the existing buildings were rebuilt in Ming-Qing. The building complex faces south, with a siheyuan layout, covering over 10 mu, with a building area of about 2,500 sq m, composed of the mountain gate, Diwan (Ten-Thousand-Enemy) Tower, left and right archways, main hall, rear hall, tomb pavilion, etc. The main buildings of Zhang Huanhou's Shrine are all laid out along the central axis. The mountain gate was built in Ming dynasty, 5 bays wide, with overhanging gable roof, and 11 six-set jiuxin bracket sets under the eaves; on both sides there are each 9m-long glazed screen walls. Crossing the mountain gate, standing before the eyes is the Diwan Tower built in Ming dynasty, 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep (10m each), the tower is over 10m high, with a post-and-lintel beam frame and double-eave xieshan roof, covered with glazed tiles, extremely gorgeous. Passing through the small square over 30m behind the Diwan Tower, the main hall, 5 bays wide and 22m wide, stands on a 2m-high stone platform base, with majestic momentum. Behind the main hall there is a corridor connecting to the rear hall and tomb pavilion. In front of the tomb pavilion there are two relief cloud-dragon stone columns with exquisite craftsmanship, lifelike. Inside the pavilion there is one stele of the Spirit Path Stele of Zhang Huanhou. Behind the pavilion is Zhang Fei's tomb; the tomb faces south, in an oval shape, 22m wide east-west, 32m long north-south, with an 8m-high earth mound; ancient trees tower on the tomb, with an extremely strong ancient and secluded feeling. Inside the shrine there are also numerous stele carvings, plaques, and couplets by famous people of various dynasties, showing the deep accumulation of Three Kingdoms historical culture. As one of the most important Three Kingdoms cultural relics in Sichuan, Zhang Huanhou's Shrine has already become a significant link in Sichuan's historical and cultural tradition.

projects.name: 川北道贡院
projects.address: 南充市阆中市保宁镇学道街中段
projects.content_zh: 阆中川北道贡院位于阆中市保宁镇学道街中段，是清代科举考试中举行乡试的地方，也称阆中贡院四川贡院。川北道贡院始建于清顺治九年(1652年)，嘉庆二十二年(1817年)川北道黎学锦率众重修，以此地位乡学，宣统二年(1910年)再次进行维修。现在所能看到的阆中清代考棚为长方形四合院，院中十字形甬道连通四方，临学道街一面是为一长排平房，中间是考生入口，俗称龙门。从龙门进去，左边是门禁(以前这里叫议察厅)右边是传达室，和它们紧连着的是号舍，也就是考生应试的地方。号舍每间约10余平方米，分为六格，每格坐一人，仅正南面出入，其他三面均被隔断。从龙门一直往前走是十字字形廊道，廊道两边设置有木椅供考生休息使用。廊道末端是殿堂(致公堂)与正厅。殿堂是临考官办公处，两侧正厅均面阔13米，进深11米，为监临、监试、巡察、同考、执调、执事等考务用房。乡试时，考官高坐殿中，四周情况可一览无余，建筑格局与考试制度相互应承，是我国古代官方制度性建筑的宝贵案例。川北道贡院曾先后举行过四次乡试，是目前全国保存最为完好的，能够看到全貌的乡试贡院，对于研究了解古代科举制度有极高的历史价值。
projects.content_en: The Chuanbeidao Examination Hall in Langzhong is located in the middle section of Xuedao Street, Baoning Town, Langzhong City. It was the place where provincial examinations (xiangshi) were held in the Qing imperial examination system, also called Langzhong Examination Hall or Sichuan Examination Hall. The Chuanbeidao Examination Hall was first built in the 9th year of Shunzhi (1652), Qing; in the 22nd year of Jiaqing (1817), Li Xuejin, the Chuanbei Circuit Intendant, led the people to rebuild it, using this place as a township school; in the 2nd year of Xuantong (1910) it underwent maintenance again. The Langzhong Qing dynasty examination shed that can be seen now is a rectangular siheyuan; in the courtyard, a cross-shaped corridor connects all four directions; the side facing Xuedao Street is a long row of bungalows, in the middle is the examinee entrance, commonly called Dragon Gate. Entering from the Dragon Gate, on the left is the access control (formerly called the Yicha Hall here) and on the right is the reception room; closely connected to them are the numbered sheds, that is, the places where examinees took the exams. Each numbered shed is about 10+ sq m, divided into six compartments, each compartment seats one person, with only the south side for entry and exit, and the other three sides all partitioned. Walking straight ahead from the Dragon Gate is a cross-shaped corridor; on both sides of the corridor there are wooden chairs for examinees to rest. At the end of the corridor are the hall (Zhigong Hall) and the main hall. The hall is the office of the chief examiner; the main halls on both sides are each 13m wide and 11m deep, serving as examination affairs rooms for the supervisor, monitor, inspector, co-examiner, coordinator, and attendant, etc. During the provincial examination, the examiner sits high in the hall, with a clear view of the surroundings; the architectural layout and the examination system correspond to each other, making it a precious case of official institutional architecture in ancient China. The Chuanbeidao Examination Hall has successively held four provincial examinations, and is currently the best-preserved provincial examination hall in the country where the full picture can be seen, with extremely high historical value for researching and understanding the ancient imperial examination system.

projects.name: 华光楼
projects.address: 南充市阆中市
projects.highlights: 跨街楼、标志性、登高远眺
projects.content_zh: 阆中华光楼又称古镇江楼，通高36米，是阆中古城楼阁中建造最早，气势最宏伟的，因此又被称作阆苑第一楼。华光楼坐落在阆中市古城区中，建筑横跨大东街南头，位于上、下华街之间，建筑面积150平方米。楼阁始建于唐，清道光年间毁于火灾，同治年间重建。华光楼底层高5米为条石砌筑，中心为横跨街道的拱券，供人车穿行之用。拱门上至今仍留有当年红四方面军粉刷的宣传标语。底座之上是三层木结构阁楼，每层均有楼梯可达，楼阁外沿均有廊道，供人们观瞻停歇。屋面采用绿色琉璃瓦铺就，三重檐，歇山顶，配有大量脊饰，屋角高翘，极为灵动。华光楼地处古城核心地带，体量高耸轻盈，作为标志性建筑给予古城强烈的可识别性与丰富的空间与形态变化，人们可以登楼一览，古城风景与山光水色尽收眼底，是古城游览的必去之处。自古以来这里就是城中最具人气的地方，金玉麟《夜登华楼》诗写道：春城天不夜，人语市如潮。就是描写华光楼附近的繁华景象。
projects.content_en: Langzhong Huaguang Tower, also called Ancient Zhenjiang Tower, has a total height of 36m. It is the earliest built and most grandly imposing among the pavilions and towers in the ancient city of Langzhong, hence it is also called the First Tower of Langyuan. Huaguang Tower is located in the ancient city area of Langzhong City; the building spans the south end of Dadong Street, situated between Upper and Lower Hua Streets, with a building area of 150 sq m. The pavilion was first built in Tang, destroyed by fire during the Qing Daoguang era, and rebuilt during the Tongzhi era. The bottom layer of Huaguang Tower is 5m high, built of dressed stones; in the center is an arch spanning the street, for the passage of people and vehicles. On the arch there still remain the propaganda slogans whitewashed by the Red Fourth Front Army in those days. Above the base is a three-story timber-structure attic; each layer has stairs accessible, and the outer edge of the attic has corridors for people to view and rest. The roof surface is paved with green glazed tiles, with triple eaves and xieshan roof, equipped with numerous ridge ornaments, and the roof corners are high and upturned, extremely agile. Huaguang Tower is located in the core area of the ancient city, with a tall and light volume; as a landmark building, it gives the ancient city strong recognizability and rich spatial and morphological changes. People can climb the tower for a panoramic view, taking in the ancient city scenery and mountain light and water color at a glance; it is a must-visit place for ancient city tours. Since ancient times this has been the most popular place in the city; Jin Yulin's poem Climbing Huaguang Tower at Night writes: The spring city has no night, human voices and markets are like the tide. This describes the bustling scene near Huaguang Tower.

projects.name: 文笔塔
projects.address: 南充市阆中市
projects.content_zh: 阆中文笔塔，又名阆中白塔，坐落在号称天下第一江山——四川阆中市城东嘉陵江外侧的白塔山上。此塔建于明代末期，是一座八边密檐十三层砖石塔，通高29米。塔身以白色粉刷，在郁郁葱葱的山丘之上极为醒目。文笔塔是一座风水塔，借着山势巍然耸立，意在震慑嘉陵江水。而也正是蜿蜒回转的嘉陵江培育了阆中古城的人文历史与大量古建筑遗迹。在2008年5月12日发生的汶川大地震中，阆中受到波及，白塔六层以上均坍塌，经认真修复，2009年已经恢复如前，重新成为阆中城的标志性建筑，继续守护着一方水土。
projects.content_en: Langzhong Wenbi (Writing Brush) Pagoda, also known as Langzhong White Pagoda, is located on White Pagoda Mountain, outside the Jialing River east of Langzhong City, Sichuan, known as the No. 1 River and Mountain Under Heaven. This pagoda was built in the late Ming dynasty; it is an octagonal dense-eave thirteen-story brick-stone pagoda, with a total height of 29m. The pagoda body is whitewashed, extremely eye-catching above the lush green hills. Wenbi Pagoda is a fengshui pagoda, standing majestically by virtue of the mountain terrain, intended to subdue the Jialing River water. And it is precisely the winding and turning Jialing River that cultivated the humanistic history and numerous ancient architectural relics of the ancient city of Langzhong. In the Wenchuan earthquake that occurred on May 12, 2008, Langzhong was affected; above the sixth story of the White Pagoda all collapsed; after careful restoration, in 2009 it had been restored as before, once again becoming the landmark building of Langzhong City, continuing to guard this land and water.

projects.name: 五龙庙文昌阁
projects.address: 阆中市思依镇河楼乡白虎村
projects.content_zh: 五龙庙文昌阁，位于阆中河楼乡白虎村五龙山麓。寺庙始建于唐代，元至正三年(1343年)重修。原有山门、戏楼、文昌阁、左右厢房等设施，现仅存文昌阁，所以并没有被列为景点，前往的人很少。文昌阁坐北向南，面阔及进深均为三间10米，高7米，抬梁式梁架，单檐歇山顶，顶覆筒瓦。大殿结构宋元特征强烈，檐柱侧脚明显，前檐下施六铺作斗拱5朵，第一跳瓜子拱作翼形拱，第二跳华拱左右出斜拱。后檐及山墙面施四铺作斗拱9朵。斗拱用料粗大，形制完整，面貌古朴。殿内采用减柱造，为元代木结构的特征。文昌阁规模虽不大，但较好保存了元代遗构，即使在四川全省境内也并不多见，具备极高的历史价值。2001年6月，被国务院列为全国重点文物保护单位。
projects.content_en: Wulong Shrine Wenchang Pavilion is located at the foot of Wulong Mountain, Baihu Village, Helou Township, Siyi Town, Langzhong. The temple was first built in Tang dynasty, and rebuilt in the 3rd year of Zhizheng (1343), Yuan. Originally it had facilities such as the mountain gate, theater tower, Wenchang Pavilion, and left and right wing rooms; currently only the Wenchang Pavilion survives, hence it has not been listed as a scenic spot, and few people visit. Wenchang Pavilion faces south, 3 bays wide and 3 bays deep (10m each), 7m high, with a post-and-lintel beam frame, single-eave xieshan roof, and the roof covered with tubular tiles. The main hall structure has strong Song-Yuan characteristics; the eave columns have obvious lateral inclination; under the front eave there are 5 six-set bracket sets, with the first-tiao guazi bracket as a wing-shaped bracket, and the second-tiao hua bracket emitting diagonal brackets left and right. The rear eave and gable wall surfaces have 9 four-set bracket sets. The bracket sets use thick and large materials, with complete form and ancient appearance. Inside the hall, column-reduction construction is adopted, a characteristic of Yuan dynasty timber structure. Although the scale of Wenchang Pavilion is not large, it relatively well preserves Yuan dynasty surviving structure, which is rare even within the entire Sichuan Province, with extremely high historical value. In June 2001, it was listed by the State Council as a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit.

projects.name: 圆觉寺
projects.address: 南充市阆中市彭城镇圆觉寺村
projects.content_zh: 圆觉寺坐落在嘉陵江畔彭城镇圆觉村，青山相拥，距阆中城约15公里。圆觉寺又名显法寺，建于唐代，是李淳风为唐太宗镇压西南王气而修建，后损毁。明洪武七年(1374年)重建，成时赐名法显寺，清乾隆年间又有扩建，是四川省级重点文物保护单位。圆觉寺原有山门、藏经楼、中殿、厢房、禅房等建筑，构成了圆觉十八殿，凤凰生九庵、站立凤凰头、望到南部县的胜景。但现在仅存大殿和禅房。殿坐西向东，面阔五间23.3米，进深四间15.8米，高13米，抬梁式梁架，重檐歇山顶，上覆灰色筒瓦。檐下遍施斗拱，上檐施六铺作斗拱50朵，下檐施六铺作斗拱32朵，并出斜拱。圆觉寺过去规模宏大，历代文人墨客留下了许多墨宝，在现在还能在圆觉寺的大殿的右侧看到多幅古代画师用矿物质颜料所作的壁画，虽然很多壁画已经残缺不全，但是从这些残余中，还是能感受到历代画师高超的技艺，细微的线条勾勒出栩栩如生的人物、山水、花草。
projects.content_en: Yuanjue Temple is located in Yuanjue Village, Pengcheng Town, on the banks of the Jialing River, embraced by green mountains, about 15km from Langzhong city. Yuanjue Temple, also known as Xianfa Temple, was built in Tang dynasty; it was built by Li Chunfeng for Tang Taizong to suppress the southwest king qi (aura), and was later damaged. It was rebuilt in the 7th year of Hongwu (1374), Ming, and upon completion was bestowed the name Faxian Temple; during the Qing Qianlong era it was further expanded, and is a Sichuan Provincial Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit. Yuanjue Temple originally had buildings such as the mountain gate, Scripture Library, middle hall, wing rooms, and meditation rooms, constituting the scenery of Eighteen Halls of Yuanjue, Phoenix Giving Birth to Nine Nunneries, Standing at the Phoenix Head, Seeing Southern County. But now only the main hall and meditation rooms survive. The hall faces east, 5 bays wide (23.3m), 4 bays deep (15.8m), 13m high, with a post-and-lintel beam frame, double-eave xieshan roof, covered with grey tubular tiles. Bracket sets are applied everywhere under the eaves; the upper eave has 50 six-set bracket sets, and the lower eave has 32 six-set bracket sets, with diagonal brackets emitted. Yuanjue Temple had a grand scale in the past; literati and scholars of various dynasties left many calligraphic treasures. Even now, on the right side of the main hall of Yuanjue Temple, one can see multiple murals made by ancient painters with mineral pigments. Although many murals are already incomplete, from these remnants one can still feel the superb skills of painters of various dynasties; fine lines outline lifelike figures, landscapes, flowers, and plants.

projects.name: 永安寺
projects.address: 阆中市水观镇永安寺村
projects.content_zh: 永安寺位于水观镇东北5公里群山环抱的黄泥岗上，距阆中城约40公里。寺庙始建于唐代，宋治平年间(1064—1067年)维修，元至顺四年(1333年)重建，明洪武年间(1368—1398年)嘉靖年间(1522—1566年)维修，是国家级文物保护单位。永安寺坐北向南，由三进四合院组成，主要建筑由山门、观音殿、大殿及左右厢房组成，占地面积约1.3万平方米，建筑面积1700平方米。其中大殿建于元顺四年(1333年)，山门、观音殿及左右厢房均为清代重建。永安寺大殿面阔三间14米，进深三间14米，高11.7米，歇山顶，抬梁式梁架。前檐下施六铺作斗拱6朵，山墙面檐柱柱头施五铺作斗拱2朵，经考证，部分为元代遗构。殿内采用减柱造，柱梁用材粗大，结构组合方式相对自由，体现了管式手法与民间传统的相互融合。大殿墙壁上原绘有壁画彩绘天龙八部图，并有元至正戊子的题记。虽已损毁，但从早期拍摄的照片上可以看到壁画线条明晰，形象生动，技法高超，是元代壁画珍品，历史与艺术价值极高。近年来有关部门又将壁画临摹复制与修整的墙面上，使大殿重复辉煌。因此极高的建筑与艺术价值，2001年永安寺被列入全国重点文物保护单位名录。
projects.content_en: Yong'an Temple is located on Huangni Ridge, surrounded by mountains, 5km northeast of Shuiguan Town, about 40km from Langzhong city. The temple was first built in Tang dynasty, maintained during the Song Zhiping era (1064-1067), rebuilt in the 4th year of Zhishun (1333), Yuan, and maintained during the Ming Hongwu era (1368-1398) and Jiajing era (1522-1566); it is a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit. Yong'an Temple faces south, composed of three siheyuan courtyards; the main buildings consist of the mountain gate, Guanyin Hall, main hall, and left and right wing rooms, covering about 13,000 sq m, with a building area of 1,700 sq m. Among them, the main hall was built in the 4th year of Zhishun (1333), Yuan; the mountain gate, Guanyin Hall, and left and right wing rooms were all rebuilt in Qing. The main hall of Yong'an Temple is 3 bays wide (14m), 3 bays deep (14m), 11.7m high, with xieshan roof and post-and-lintel beam frame. Under the front eave there are 6 six-set bracket sets; on the eave column capitals of the gable wall surface there are 2 five-set bracket sets; after research, part of them are Yuan dynasty surviving structures. Inside the hall, column-reduction construction is adopted; the columns and beams use thick and large materials, and the structural combination method is relatively free, reflecting the mutual integration of tubular techniques and folk traditions. On the walls of the main hall there were originally painted murals of the Color Painting of the Eight Legions of Heavenly Dragons, with an inscription of Yuan Zhizheng Wuzi. Although already damaged, from early photographs one can see that the murals have clear lines, vivid images, and superb techniques; they are Yuan dynasty mural treasures, with extremely high historical and artistic value. In recent years, relevant departments have copied and reproduced the murals on the restored wall surfaces, making the main hall regain its brilliance. Due to its extremely high architectural and artistic value, in 2001 Yong'an Temple was included in the list of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units.

projects.name: 天宫院
projects.address: 南充市阆中市天宫乡
projects.highlights: 风水、天文历法、明代建筑
projects.content_zh: 天宫院位于四川省阆中市南20里处的天宫乡。唐代时，因阆中风水奇佳，天文学家袁天罡、李淳风先后来此观测天象，晚年均定居阆中西河畔，继续测地观天、著书立说。他们去世后分别葬于观稼山和五里台，乡人为纪念两位古代天文历算学家在此建天宫院，现为省级文物保护单位。天宫院是一座两进四合院建筑群，原有山门、亭子楼、大雄宝殿及后殿等建筑，现仅存大雄宝殿及后殿。大雄宝殿建于明天顺三年(1459年)，五间19.4米，进深三间9.4米，高8.7米，重檐歇山顶，穿斗式梁架，顶覆青瓦。大殿较为完整地展现了明代大木构特征，但也存在根据民间建筑传统所做的修整。后殿(观音殿)为清雍正七年(1729年)重建，面阔五间14.5米，进深三间5.5米，高7米，悬山顶，抬梁穿斗式混合结构。因为袁天罡、李淳风在我国地理与天文发展史上的特殊地位，再加上天宫乡独特的风水优势，使得天宫院成为了解我国传统风水文化与天文历法知识体系的重要场所。
projects.content_en: Tiangong (Heavenly Palace) Hall is located in Tiangong Township, 20 li south of Langzhong City, Sichuan Province. In Tang dynasty, because Langzhong had excellent fengshui, astronomers Yuan Tiangang and Li Chunfeng successively came here to observe celestial phenomena; in their later years they both settled by the Xi River in Langzhong, continuing to measure the earth, observe the sky, and write books. After their deaths, they were respectively buried on Guanjia Mountain and Wulitai; villagers built Tiangong Hall here to commemorate the two ancient astronomical and calendrical scholars, and it is now a provincial cultural relic protection unit. Tiangong Hall is a two-courtyard siheyuan building complex; originally it had buildings such as the mountain gate, pavilion tower, Mahavira Hall, and rear hall; currently only the Mahavira Hall and rear hall survive. The Mahavira Hall was built in the 3rd year of Tianshun (1459), Ming; it is 5 bays wide (19.4m), 3 bays deep (9.4m), 8.7m high, with double-eave xieshan roof, chuan-dou beam frame, and roof covered with grey tiles. The main hall relatively completely shows the characteristics of Ming dynasty large timber structure, but there also exist renovations made according to folk architectural traditions. The rear hall (Guanyin Hall) was rebuilt in the 7th year of Yongzheng (1729), Qing; it is 5 bays wide (14.5m), 3 bays deep (5.5m), 7m high, with overhanging gable roof and mixed post-and-lintel and chuan-dou structure. Because of Yuan Tiangang and Li Chunfeng's special position in the history of China's geographical and astronomical development, plus the unique fengshui advantage of Tiangong Township, Tiangong Hall has become an important place for understanding China's traditional fengshui culture and the knowledge system of astronomy and calendrics.

projects.name: 丁氏庄园
projects.address: 南充市仪陇县马鞍镇琳琅村
projects.content_zh: 丁氏庄园位于南充市仪陇县马鞍镇琳琅村，民间俗称丁家大院丁家花园，它是清末民初当地首富客家人后裔丁邱南、丁邱毓、丁邱玉、丁邱珍四兄弟主持修建的一座家族庄园。丁氏庄园坐北朝南，占地面积达5800平方米，建筑面积为5400平方米，共有大小房间108间。庄园规模宏大，集居住与防卫为一体，在民国时期号称川北第一庄，是川北地区客家建筑文化的代表性案例。丁氏庄园属于多重四合院布局，开有东西两个院门。建筑群核心是一个大四合院，面积达437平方米。正房位于大院南北，均为悬山顶，穿斗式梁架。其中背面正房面阔五间25.7米，其中明间为上堂屋；南面，正房面阔五间25.7米，其中明间为下堂屋。大院东西两侧还各有一个小院，院中有水池，一座石桥跨池而过，十分独特。小天井之前、后分别为恒堂屋及退堂屋。除了住宅功能外，庄园也非常重视防御性，大院东北角设有碉楼堡，面阔三间18.7米，进深二间12米，高14.5米，四面均设有枪眼，便于防御入口。庄园四周采用封闭而坚固的墙面，展现典型的客家聚居性建筑特征。
projects.content_en: Ding's Mansion is located in Linlang Village, Maan Town, Yilong County, Nanchong City. Commonly known among the people as the Ding Family Great Courtyard or Ding Family Garden, it is a family mansion presided over and built by the four brothers Ding Qiunan, Ding Qiuyu, Ding Qiuyu, and Ding Qiuzhen, descendants of the local wealthiest Hakka people, in the late Qing and early Republican period. Ding's Mansion faces south, covering an area of 5,800 sq m, with a building area of 5,400 sq m, and a total of 108 rooms large and small. The mansion has a grand scale, integrating residence and defense; during the Republican period it was known as the No. 1 Mansion in Northern Sichuan, and is a representative case of Hakka architectural culture in the northern Sichuan region. Ding's Mansion belongs to a multiple siheyuan layout, with east and west courtyard gates opened. The core of the building complex is a large siheyuan, with an area of 437 sq m. The main houses are located in the north and south of the great courtyard, both with overhanging gable roofs and chuan-dou beam frames. Among them, the back main house is 5 bays wide (25.7m), with the central bay as the upper main hall; on the south side, the main house is 5 bays wide (25.7m), with the central bay as the lower main hall. On the east and west sides of the great courtyard there is also a small courtyard each; in the courtyard there is a pool, and a stone bridge crosses over the pool, very unique. Before and after the small courtyard are respectively the Heng main hall and the Tui main hall. Besides residential function, the mansion also attaches great importance to defensiveness; at the northeast corner of the great courtyard there is a watchtower fort, 3 bays wide (18.7m), 2 bays deep (12m), 14.5m high, with gun holes on all four sides, convenient for defending the entrance. Around the mansion, closed and solid walls are adopted, showing typical Hakka communal-living architectural characteristics.

projects.name: 观音庵
projects.address: 南充市南部县平桥乡谢家楼村
projects.content_zh: 观音庵位于南充市南部县平桥乡谢家楼村，交通特别不方便，没有直达的车，并且只有乡间小道，大型的车辆很难通过。观音庵始建年代不详，但建筑形制与该县其他明代建筑相近，推断为始建于建于明代。庵中原有前、中、后殿及戏台，现仅存中殿，推测始建于明，清同治五年(1866年)维修。中殿面阔三间12.14米，进深11.05米，高8.55米，歇山顶，抬梁式梁架，檐下施六铺作斗拱16朵，并出斜拱。整个木结构保存状况良好，用材硕大，柱础、柱侧角、以及斗拱构造都体现出明代建筑的特征。或许是居于偏远乡村，使得中殿近400年来未受大的损伤，实为幸事，是川东北地区并不多见的明代建筑范例。
projects.content_en: Guanyin Nunnery is located in Xiejialou Village, Pingqiao Township, Nanbu County, Nanchong City. Transportation is particularly inconvenient; there is no direct bus, and there are only country paths, making it difficult for large vehicles to pass. The founding date of Guanyin Nunnery is unknown, but its architectural form is similar to other Ming dynasty buildings in the county, so it is inferred to have been first built in Ming dynasty. The nunnery originally had front, middle, and rear halls and a theater tower; currently only the middle hall survives, inferred to have been first built in Ming and maintained in the 5th year of Tongzhi (1866), Qing. The middle hall is 3 bays wide (12.14m), 11.05m deep, 8.55m high, with xieshan roof and post-and-lintel beam frame; under the eaves there are 16 six-set bracket sets, with diagonal brackets emitted. The entire timber structure is in good preservation condition, with large materials; the column bases, column lateral inclination, and bracket set construction all reflect the characteristics of Ming dynasty architecture. Perhaps because it is located in a remote countryside, the middle hall has not suffered major damage in the past 400 years — truly a fortunate thing, and a rare example of Ming dynasty architecture in the northeastern Sichuan region.

projects.name: 西充文庙
projects.address: 南充市西充县晋城镇莲花湖
projects.content_zh: 西充文庙位于南充市西充县晋城镇莲花湖，虽然地处闹市，但是它依然保留着古老的历史古韵。西充文庙始建于南宋淳祐年间(1241—1252年)，明弘治十五年(1502年)重建，清代多次修缮。2002年原拆原建搬迁至莲花湖北岸址。在川北各地的文庙中，西充文庙规模最大，保存也最为完整。文庙现坐北朝南，两进四合院结构，主要建筑沿中轴布置，由南至北依次建有：棂星门、泮池、大成门、大成殿等建筑。棂星门四柱三间，宽9米，明间刻楷书棂星门三字，次间分别刻有金声玉振四字。大成门面阔三间13.7米，进深二间4.96米，通高7.11米，穿斗式梁架，悬山顶。大成殿规模最为宏大，面阔三间15.04米，进深12.31米，通高11.30米，抬梁式结构，重檐歇山顶，檐下施五彩斗拱。殿内梁架上有弘治拾伍年壬戌拾冬月望日望日重建立，以及一笔文明新气象，千年朱四旧规模等墨书题记。西充文庙布局严谨，建筑精巧别致，院内绿树成荫，环境优美，是四川地区重要的文庙建筑遗存，现为省级文物保护单位。
projects.content_en: The Temple of Confucius in Xichong is located at Lianhua Lake, Jincheng Town, Xichong County, Nanchong City. Although located in a busy downtown area, it still retains the ancient historical charm. The Temple of Confucius in Xichong was first built during the Southern Song Chunyou era (1241-1252), rebuilt in the 15th year of Hongzhi (1502), Ming, and repaired multiple times in Qing. In 2002 it was dismantled and rebuilt in situ, relocated to the north bank of Lianhua Lake. Among the Confucian temples in various places in northern Sichuan, the Temple of Confucius in Xichong has the largest scale and is the most completely preserved. The temple currently faces south, with a two-courtyard siheyuan structure; the main buildings are arranged along the central axis, built sequentially from south to north: the Lingxing Gate, Pan Pool, Dacheng Gate, Dacheng Hall, etc. The Lingxing Gate has four columns and three bays, 9m wide; the central bay is engraved with the three regular-script characters Lingxing Gate, and the secondary bays are respectively engraved with the four characters Jinsheng Yuzhen (Golden Sound and Jade Vibration). The Dacheng Gate is 3 bays wide (13.7m), 2 bays deep (4.96m), with a total height of 7.11m, chuan-dou beam frame, overhanging gable roof. The Dacheng Hall has the grandest scale, 3 bays wide (15.04m), 12.31m deep, with a total height of 11.30m, post-and-lintel structure, double-eave xieshan roof, with five-color bracket sets under the eaves. On the beam frame inside the hall there are ink inscriptions such as Rebuilt and Erected on the 15th Day of the 10th Lunar Month in the Renxu Year, the 15th Year of Hongzhi, as well as A Stroke of Civilization Brings New Atmosphere, A Thousand Years of Zhu Si Retains Old Scale, etc. The Temple of Confucius in Xichong has a rigorous layout, with exquisite and unique buildings; inside the courtyard green trees form shade, with a beautiful environment. It is an important surviving Confucian temple building in the Sichuan region, and is currently a provincial cultural relic protection unit.

projects.name: 百福寺
projects.address: 南充市西充县仁和镇百福寺村
projects.content_zh: 百福寺位于南充市西充县仁和镇百福寺村岁堂山上。寺庙始建于隋，古称百福禅关，是古代西充八景之一。古寺后毁于兵火，明永乐三年(1405年)重建。百福寺坐北朝南，为合院布局，现存山门、正殿与右禅房。山门为木结构牌楼式建筑，前檐面阔五间，后檐面阔三间14.36米，进深五间8.96米，通高8.10米。前檐明间悬挂隋代进士程太虚题写的自天降康匾额一道，后檐在过道至上架设戏楼(万年台)，结构独特。正殿面阔三间14.00米，进深四间14.33米，通高8.83米，抬梁式梁架，单檐歇山顶，檐下施斗拱，均为五铺作计心造。殿内采用移柱造，殿内中柱向外移1.03米，结构复杂。正殿梁架斗拱均保存完好，古朴敦厚，体现出明代早期木构建筑特征。寺庙周边有几百年树龄古柏数十棵，郁郁葱葱，是人们寻古探幽的绝佳去处。
projects.content_en: Baifu Temple is located on Suitang Mountain, Baifusi Village, Renhe Town, Xichong County, Nanchong City. The temple was first built in Sui dynasty, anciently called Baifu Chan Pass, one of the Eight Scenes of ancient Xichong. The ancient temple was later destroyed by war and fire, and rebuilt in the 3rd year of Yongle (1405), Ming. Baifu Temple faces south, with a courtyard layout; currently surviving are the mountain gate, main hall, and right meditation room.
