The mountain gate is a timber-structure archway-style building; the front eave is 5 bays wide, the rear eave is 3 bays wide (14.36m), 5 bays deep (8.96m), with a total height of 8.10m. On the front eave central bay there hangs one plaque of Health Descends from Heaven inscribed by Sui dynasty jinshi Cheng Taixu; on the rear eave, a theater tower (Wannian Platform) is erected from the passageway upward, with a unique structure. The main hall is 3 bays wide (14.00m), 4 bays deep (14.33m), with a total height of 8.83m, post-and-lintel beam frame, single-eave xieshan roof, with bracket sets under the eaves, all of five-set jiuxin construction. Inside the hall, column-shifting construction is adopted; the central columns inside the hall are shifted outward by 1.03m, with a complex structure. The beam frame and bracket sets of the main hall are all well preserved, simple and honest, reflecting the characteristics of early Ming dynasty timber structure architecture. Around the temple there are dozens of ancient cypresses several hundred years old, lush and green, an excellent place for people to seek ancient traces and explore secluded places.

projects.name: 圭心寺
projects.address: 南充市西充县双凤镇圭心寺村
projects.content_zh: 圭心寺，又称圭心禅院，位于四川省西充县双凤镇圭心寺村。寺庙始建于唐朝初年，是佛教华严宗五祖圭峰禅师曾经修行的道场。历史上古刹几经损毁，明洪武八年(1375年)重建，清雍正二年(1724年)与清乾隆六十年(1795年)进一步重修，始成当下规模。圭心寺坐北向南，合院布局，占地10,000平方米，建筑面积3,000平方米，主体建筑包括前殿、正殿与禅房，其中正殿为明代建筑，其余为清代修建。前殿(天王殿)面阔五间20.4米，进深三间8.6米，高6.8米，悬山顶，穿斗式梁架。正殿面阔三间10.85米、进深五间10.85米，高8.01米，抬梁式梁架，单檐歇山顶。檐下施斗拱，前檐为五铺作计心造，角柱上施转角铺作。圭心寺院内现存一棵千年古榕，直径两米而枝叶繁茂，庇荫数百平方米，甚为壮观。当地民间留下诸多与古寺古榕有关的传说，为古寺增加了更多传奇色彩。
projects.content_en: Guixin Temple, also called Guixin Chan Courtyard, is located in Guixinsi Village, Shuangfeng Town, Xichong County, Sichuan Province. The temple was first built in the early Tang dynasty, and was the practice place where Guifeng Chan Master, the 5th patriarch of the Buddhist Huayan sect, once practiced. Historically the ancient temple was damaged and restored several times; rebuilt in the 8th year of Hongwu (1375), Ming, and further rebuilt in the 2nd year of Yongzheng (1724) and the 60th year of Qianlong (1795), Qing, finally reaching its current scale. Guixin Temple faces south, with a courtyard layout, covering 10,000 sq m, with a building area of 3,000 sq m; the main buildings include the front hall, main hall, and meditation rooms, among which the main hall is a Ming dynasty building, and the rest were built in Qing. The front hall (Heavenly Kings Hall) is 5 bays wide (20.4m), 3 bays deep (8.6m), 6.8m high, with overhanging gable roof and chuan-dou beam frame. The main hall is 3 bays wide (10.85m), 5 bays deep (10.85m), 8.01m high, with post-and-lintel beam frame and single-eave xieshan roof. Bracket sets are applied under the eaves; the front eave is of five-set jiuxin construction, and corner bracket sets are applied on the corner columns. In the courtyard of Guixin Temple there currently survives a thousand-year-old ancient banyan, with a diameter of two meters and lush branches and leaves, shading several hundred square meters, very spectacular. Local folklore has left many legends related to the ancient temple and ancient banyan, adding more legendary color to the ancient temple.

projects.name: 西充占山寺
projects.address: 南充市西充县占山乡
projects.content_zh: 占山寺位于西充县占山乡，始建于唐，元代维修，明代重建。寺庙原为合院布局，占地约630平方米，现有建筑仅存正殿，为明代建造。正殿面阔五间19.4米，进深五间14.35米，高7.2米，穿斗抬梁混合式梁架，歇山顶。正殿虽未施斗拱，更多采用民间建筑做法，但结构用材粗大，梁柱均极为粗壮，古朴敦厚，气韵十足。现殿内梁架上仍然留有明清时期彩绘卷草纹图案，以及明初先辈建立墨书题记，非常珍贵。
projects.content_en: Zhanshan Temple is located in Zhanshan Township, Xichong County. It was first built in Tang, maintained in Yuan, and rebuilt in Ming. The temple originally had a courtyard layout, covering about 630 sq m; the existing buildings only have the main hall surviving, built in Ming dynasty. The main hall is 5 bays wide (19.4m), 5 bays deep (14.35m), 7.2m high, with a mixed chuan-dou and post-and-lintel beam frame and xieshan roof. Although the main hall does not apply bracket sets and more adopts folk architectural methods, the structural materials are thick and large, with both beams and columns extremely sturdy, simple and honest, full of charm. Currently on the beam frame inside the hall there still remain colored painting scroll-grass patterns from the Ming-Qing period, as well as an ink inscription of Established by Ancestors in Early Ming, very precious.

projects.name: 中心镇古建筑群
projects.name_en: Ancient Building Complex in Zhongxin Town
projects.address: 广安市武胜县中心镇
projects.content_zh: 中心古建筑群位于广安武胜县中心镇，整体坐落在嘉陵江右岸的台地之上。此处古为定远县治所在地，后于20世纪50年代因交通不甚方便而迁徙至沿口镇。400余年的历史沧桑，在中心镇留下了丰富的文化遗迹，中心古建筑群现为四川省级文化保护单位。中心古建筑群现在存有明城墙、文庙、武庙、城隍庙、万寿宫、传教士故宅等历史建筑遗迹。其中，城墙始筑于嘉靖时期，墙体由条石叠砌、内施夯土构筑，现存北门、西门、东门三处残段共300余米。文庙始建于清雍正时期，现仅存大成门与大成殿，均为穿斗叠梁式结构。武庙、城隍庙与万寿宫皆始建于清朝，虽年久失修，但整体结构仍基本保存完好。传教士故宅为工艺精良的西式建筑，保存相对完好。
projects.content_en: The Ancient Building Complex in Zhongxin Town is located in Zhongxin Town, Wusheng County, Guang'an, overall situated on the terrace on the right bank of the Jialing River. This place was anciently the seat of Dingyuan County, and later in the 1950s, due to inconvenient transportation, it was relocated to Yankou Town. Over 400 years of historical vicissitudes have left rich cultural relics in Zhongxin Town; the Ancient Building Complex in Zhongxin is now a Sichuan Provincial Cultural Protection Unit. The Ancient Building Complex in Zhongxin currently has surviving historical building relics such as the Ming city wall, Confucian Temple, Martial Temple, City God Temple, Wanshou Palace, and Missionary's Former Residence. Among them, the city wall was first built during the Jiajing period; the wall body is constructed by叠砌 dressed stones with rammed earth inside; currently there are three remaining sections at the North Gate, West Gate, and East Gate, totaling over 300m. The Confucian Temple was first built during the Qing Yongzheng period; currently only the Dacheng Gate and Dacheng Hall survive, both with chuan-dou and叠梁 structure. The Martial Temple, City God Temple, and Wanshou Palace were all first built in Qing dynasty; although long in disrepair, their overall structures are still basically well preserved. The Missionary's Former Residence is a Western-style building with exquisite craftsmanship, relatively well preserved.

projects.name: 宝箴塞
projects.address: 广安市武胜县宝箴塞乡方家沟村
projects.content_zh: 宝箴塞位于广安市武胜县宝箴塞乡方家沟村，始建于清宣统年间，为当地富豪段氏家族为防战乱所建，后于民国增修。依山而筑的宝箴塞集军事防御与生活起居功能于一身，于2006年被国务院列为全国第六批重点文物保护单位，现为国家4A级风景区。宝箴塞整体由条石构筑而成，呈东西宽阔、中间狭长之态，建筑风格独特，既有闽南团城重于防御的设计，亦有江南民居古韵十足的布局。塞内建筑规模较大，有四座院落，七个天井，上百间房屋，水井、仓库、戏楼等生活设施一应俱全，令人惊叹。此外，塞内还有坚固的防御工事，守护者既可在塞墙上防御，也可在城垛上机动作战，加之密密麻麻的射击孔，复杂的地下通道，长达千米的环形炮楼，互相防守的众多小塞，防御网络堪称完美，令人佩服。院内还用条石砌有一座高耸的碉楼，四周布设枪眼，具有易守难攻的优势，展现出宝箴塞全面的防御设计。无怪中国古建筑专家组组长罗哲文称赞宝箴塞为全国罕有，蜀中一绝。
projects.content_en: Baozhen Fortress is located in Fangjiagou Village, Baozhensai Township, Wusheng County, Guang'an City. It was first built during the Qing Xuantong era, built by the wealthy local Duan family to prevent war and chaos, and later expanded during the Republican period. Built according to the mountain, Baozhen Fortress integrates military defense and living functions; in 2006 it was listed by the State Council as the 6th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units, and is now a national 4A-level scenic area. Baozhen Fortress is overall constructed of dressed stones,呈现 a state of broad east-west and narrow middle; its architectural style is unique, with both the Minnan (Southern Fujian)团城 design emphasizing defense, and a layout full of the ancient charm of Jiangnan residences. The buildings inside the fortress are relatively large in scale, with four courtyards, seven skylights, over a hundred rooms, and living facilities such as wells, warehouses, and theater towers all complete — amazing. In addition, inside the fortress there are also solid defense works; guardians can both defend on the fortress walls and maneuver on the crenellations; plus the dense shooting holes, complex underground passages, kilometer-long circular watchtowers, and numerous small fortresses defending each other, the defense network can be called perfect, admirable. Inside the courtyard there is also a tall watchtower built of dressed stones, with gun holes arranged around it, having the advantage of easy defense and difficult attack, showing Baozhen Fortress's comprehensive defense design. No wonder Luo Zhewen, head of the Chinese Ancient Architecture Expert Group, praised Baozhen Fortress as rare nationwide and a unique wonder in Shu (Sichuan).

projects.name: 褒先寺
projects.address: 广安市华蓥市永兴镇安丙街
projects.content_zh: 褒先寺位于广安市华蓥市永兴镇安丙街，为南宋四川宣抚使安丙的生祠，后毁于明朝战乱，于清朝重修并改建为佛寺，现为省级文物保护单位。褒先寺坐南朝北，主要有山门，前、正、后殿、左右厢房等建筑，格局较为完整。山门由青石砌筑，质朴厚重，散发着岁月特有的美感。寺庙现已人迹罕至，被当成重要文物保护对象而关闭起来，寺内只有一位沧桑的守寺人与他凶猛的狗。我们进寺很是费了一番功夫。前殿供奉着一座弥勒佛，陈旧的香案上摆放着些许祭祀的鲜花，佛像上也落满了灰尘，破旧的前殿显得相当寂寥。前殿与正殿之中是一座清幽的院落，流水、石桥、古树似乎诉说着褒先寺往日的辉煌荣光。正殿的青瓦屋顶上点缀着众多雕刻精美的瑞兽。殿内树立着描述安丙辉煌事迹的雕刻，还有众多古朴的佛像，只可惜，佛像的头部大多损毁，据守寺老人介绍，这些佛像大多都是在文革中被砸坏的，着实令人可惜。褒先寺现正处于重修状态，相信经过保护之后的寺庙，一定能够重复往日光彩。
projects.content_en: Baoxian Temple is located on Anbing Street, Yongxing Town, Huaying City, Guang'an. It was the living shrine of An Bing, the Sichuan Xuanfu (Pacification Commissioner) of Southern Song, later destroyed in Ming dynasty war chaos, and rebuilt and converted into a Buddhist temple in Qing dynasty; it is now a provincial cultural relic protection unit. Baoxian Temple faces north, mainly with buildings such as the mountain gate, front, main, and rear halls, and left and right wing rooms, with a relatively complete layout. The mountain gate is built of bluestone, simple and heavy, exuding the unique beauty of time. The temple is now rarely visited, closed as an important cultural relic protection object; inside the temple there is only a weathered temple keeper and his fierce dog. It took us quite some effort to enter the temple. The front hall enshrines a Maitreya Buddha; on the old incense table there are placed some sacrificial flowers, and the Buddha statue is also covered with dust; the dilapidated front hall appears quite desolate. Between the front hall and the main hall is a serene courtyard; flowing water, stone bridge, and ancient trees seem to tell of the past glory and splendor of Baoxian Temple. On the grey tile roof of the main hall there are dotted numerous exquisitely carved auspicious beasts. Inside the hall there stand carvings describing An Bing's brilliant deeds, as well as many simple and ancient Buddha statues; unfortunately, most of the heads of the Buddha statues are damaged; according to the temple keeper, most of these Buddha statues were smashed during the Cultural Revolution, truly regrettable. Baoxian Temple is currently in a state of reconstruction; I believe that after protection, the temple will surely regain its former glory.

projects.name: 广安白塔
projects.address: 广安市广安区县城南渠江之畔
projects.content_zh: 广安白塔位于广安市广安区县城南渠江之畔，又名舍利宝塔，为褒先寺故主南宋四川宣抚使安丙主持修建，现为全国第七批重点文物保护单位。白塔坐南朝北，是一座砖石堆砌而成的四方形楼阁式宝塔，底边长近6米，通高33.6米，历经数百年风雨，却仍保存得较为完整。塔的造型独特，塔底一到五级为条石筑造，六至九级改由方砖垒成，由底层至顶逐层内缩。广安白塔与其他一般样式的塔不同之处在于塔顶没有宝顶与塔刹，而是以一座砖砌的方室为顶。方室南北方设有门洞，可从此出到方室四周的走道，进而眺望四周美景，着实匠心独运。塔南开有拱门，但由于塔身已经破损明显，加之塔基部分坍塌，已成危楼，塔身从底至上五层皆设有券门，上刻石像或用来放置佛像。六到九级则开有窗洞以便浏览四周风景。
projects.content_en: Guang'an White Pagoda is located on the banks of the Qu River, south of the county town of Guang'an District, Guang'an City. Also known as the Relic Stupa, it was presided over and built by An Bing, the former master of Baoxian Temple and the Sichuan Xuanfu Commissioner of Southern Song; it is now the 7th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units. The White Pagoda faces north, a square pavilion-style pagoda built of bricks and stones, with a bottom side length of nearly 6m and a total height of 33.6m; after hundreds of years of wind and rain, it is still relatively well preserved. The pagoda has a unique shape; the first to fifth levels of the pagoda base are built of dressed stones, and the sixth to ninth levels are changed to be built of square bricks, tapering inward layer by layer from the bottom to the top. The difference between Guang'an White Pagoda and other generally styled pagodas is that the pagoda top has no precious top or pagoda finial, but instead takes a brick-built square room as the top. On the north and south sides of the square room there are door openings, from which one can exit to the walkway around the square room, and then overlook the beautiful scenery around — truly ingenious. An arched door is opened on the south of the pagoda, but because the pagoda body has obvious damage, plus the partial collapse of the pagoda base, it has become a dangerous building; from the bottom to the fifth level of the pagoda body there are all arched doors, on which stone statues are carved or used to place Buddha statues. The sixth to ninth levels have window openings opened for viewing the surrounding scenery.

projects.name: 兴国寺
projects.address: 广安市广安区滨江大道南段
projects.content_zh: 兴国寺位于广安市广安区滨江大道南段，始建于明代，原为众多明代建筑聚集而成的庞大的建筑群，现仅存大殿。兴国寺大殿建于明代，建筑整体保存得较为完全，格局形式坐南向北，是广安不可多得的较为完整的殿堂建筑。大殿建筑庄严肃穆，富有典型的明代特色。屋顶上覆绿色琉璃瓦，碧瓦朱梁，显得精美华贵。殿内顶饰藻井，显得十分开阔。大殿由朱红立柱支撑，内供奉着释迦牟尼佛，慈悲庄严。寺庙内的香火鼎盛，不时有游客往来进行拜祭。殿内还留有前人墨宝唐朝敬恭州年农年丙子正月初一丙申朔月二十日庚申吉旦兴国寺住持修造及广安千户守御所武德将军正千户亦铭、武略将军副千户吴源史等题记。在兴国寺大殿的左右还有几座仿古佛寺楼阁，映衬着古殿，焕发兴国寺特有的韵味。
projects.content_en: Xingguo Temple is located in the southern section of Binjiang Avenue, Guang'an District, Guang'an City. It was first built in Ming dynasty, originally a large building complex gathered from numerous Ming dynasty buildings; currently only the main hall survives. The main hall of Xingguo Temple was built in Ming dynasty; the building overall is relatively completely preserved, with a layout facing north, and is a rare relatively complete hall building in Guang'an. The main hall building is solemn and majestic, rich in typical Ming dynasty characteristics. The roof is covered with green glazed tiles, with green tiles and vermilion beams, appearing exquisite and luxurious. Inside the hall the ceiling is decorated with a caisson, appearing very open. The main hall is supported by vermilion columns, inside which Shakyamuni Buddha is enshrined, compassionate and solemn. The incense in the temple is flourishing, and from time to time tourists come and go to worship. Inside the hall there are also left the calligraphic treasures of predecessors: inscriptions such as Built by the Abbot of Xingguo Temple on the Auspicious Day of Gengshen, the 20th Day of the First Lunar Month, Bingzi Year, Nong Year of Jinggong Prefecture, Tang dynasty, and Wude General Zheng Qianhu Yiming, Wulue General Vice Qianhu Wu Yuanshi of the Guang'an Qianhu Garrison, etc. On the left and right of the main hall of Xingguo Temple there are also several antique Buddhist temple pavilions, setting off the ancient hall and radiating the unique charm of Xingguo Temple.

projects.name: 冲相寺及摩崖造像
projects.address: 广安市广安区肖溪镇冲相村
projects.content_zh: 冲相寺及摩崖造像位于广安市广安区东北部的肖溪镇，坐落于冲相村的定光岩。冲相寺始建于隋文帝时期，本来的名称为药寺，后于唐易名为冲相，是唐末高僧定光古佛的道场，现为全国第七批重点文物保护单位。冲相寺现仅存重修过的正殿与右厢房，正殿与右厢房分别重建于康熙年间和民国晚期。在冲相寺外的定光岩石壁上，分布着隋唐时期开凿的50龛造像，据相关资料介绍，50龛造像之中，有15龛100尊隋代造像，另有35龛300余尊唐代造像。摩崖造像在巴渝地区的石窟造像之中甚为主流，而冲相寺摩崖造像更是其典型代表。冲相寺摩崖石刻的内容纷繁复杂，有日常的生产生活，也有诗词歌赋、游人题记等。在冲相寺的摩崖造像之中，最为著名的当属岩壁上层正中的隋定光佛造像。定光佛造像高达4米，是国内目前保存最为完整、规模最大的定光佛造像。此外，冲相寺还保存着唐代遗存的游览线路图，甚是珍贵。冲相寺现存正殿及右厢房，其中正殿重建于康熙五十七年(1719年)，面阔5间21米，进深6间8米，单檐歇山式屋顶，叠梁式屋架。厢房为民国晚期所建。
projects.content_en: Chongxiang Temple and Cliffside Statues are located in Xiaoxi Town, northeast of Guang'an District, Guang'an City, situated on Dingguang Rock in Chongxiang Village. Chongxiang Temple was first built during the Sui Wendi period; its original name was Yao (Medicine) Temple, later renamed Chongxiang in Tang; it was the practice place of the eminent monk Dingguang Ancient Buddha of late Tang, and is now the 7th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units. Chongxiang Temple currently only has the rebuilt main hall and right wing room surviving; the main hall and right wing room were respectively rebuilt during the Kangxi era and late Republican period. On the Dingguang Rock cliff outside Chongxiang Temple, there are distributed 50 niches of statues excavated during the Sui-Tang period; according to relevant materials, among the 50 niches of statues, there are 15 niches with 100 Sui dynasty statues, and another 35 niches with over 300 Tang dynasty statues. Cliffside statues are very mainstream among the grotto statues in the Bayu (Chongqing) region, and the Chongxiang Temple cliffside statues are even more its typical representative. The content of the Chongxiang Temple cliffside carvings is numerous and complex, including daily production and life, as well as poetry and songs, tourist inscriptions, etc. Among the cliffside statues of Chongxiang Temple, the most famous is undoubtedly the Sui Dingguang Buddha statue in the center of the upper layer of the cliff wall. The Dingguang Buddha statue is up to 4m high, and is currently the most completely preserved and largest-scale Dingguang Buddha statue in China. In addition, Chongxiang Temple also preserves a Tang dynasty surviving tour route map, very precious. Chongxiang Temple currently has the main hall and right wing room surviving; among them, the main hall was rebuilt in the 57th year of Kangxi (1719), 5 bays wide (21m), 6 bays deep (8m), with single-eave xieshan roof and叠梁 roof frame. The wing room was built in the late Republican period.

projects.name: 龙爪塔
projects.address: 达州市通川区塔坨广场旁
projects.content_zh: 龙爪塔坐落于四川省达州市通川区塔坨广场旁的玉印山上，该塔建于唐朝年间，清代经历两次大规模修整。龙爪塔高30米，占地57.4平方米，塔身九级八面，呈八角锥形，通体由素白的塔身和黑亮的屋檐交替而成，敦实古朴，矗立在郁郁葱葱的玉印山上显得格外醒目。砖石结构的龙爪塔内有盘旋的栏道，塔底端坐的佛像和塔顶直立的观音像都可供游客参拜。龙爪塔临江而建，高居山顶，景观独特，历代诗人对此留下不少赞颂的名句。从龙爪塔顶向四周眺望，能够看到州河、州河大桥，达州城景等重要景观，气象万千，而白塔本身也成为达州城的标志性建筑之一。
projects.content_en: Longzhao (Dragon-Claw) Pagoda is located on Yuyin Mountain, beside Tatuo Square, Tongchuan District, Dazhou City, Sichuan Province. This pagoda was built during the Tang dynasty, and underwent two large-scale renovations in Qing dynasty. Longzhao Pagoda is 30m high, covering 57.4 sq m; the pagoda body has nine levels and eight sides, in an octagonal conical shape; the whole body is formed by the alternation of plain white pagoda body and black-bright eaves, solid and simple, standing on the lush Yuyin Mountain and appearing particularly eye-catching. Inside the brick-stone structure Longzhao Pagoda there are winding corridors; the Buddha statue sitting at the bottom of the pagoda and the Guanyin statue standing upright at the top of the pagoda are both available for tourists to worship. Longzhao Pagoda was built facing the river, high on the mountain top, with unique scenery; poets of various dynasties left many famous lines praising it. Looking around from the top of Longzhao Pagoda, one can see important landscapes such as the Zhou River, Zhou River Bridge, and Dazhou city scenery, with myriad phenomena; and the White Pagoda itself has also become one of the landmark buildings of Dazhou city.

projects.name: 真佛山群庙
projects.address: 达州市达县福善乡清河村
projects.content_zh: 真佛山群庙位于四川达州市达县福善乡清河村以南的真佛山。这是难得的集儒、释、道三教为一体的群庙建筑。道光十八年(1838年)竣工的群庙前后经多次修整，寺庙建筑保存完好，于1981年位于省级文物保护单位之列，现为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。真佛山群庙在海拔710米的高山上依山势而造，与周围茂盛的林木相映成趣。群庙的总占地面积为4万平方米，当中的建筑面积有1.5万平方米，规模庞大，均是传统的四合院布局，顺着延绵的山势铺陈直达巍峨的山顶。从山脚至山门共有1179级石阶，由山门向上依次为戏楼、天王殿、天子殿、德化寺、大雄宝殿等建筑，建筑多为近年整修，采用清代建筑式样，古迹不多。虽然古风不再，但身处青山佛庙之中，望着袅袅的云烟、听着悠扬的钟声、闻着幽幽的焚香，仿佛置身世外，颇有超凡脱俗之感。
projects.content_en: The Temples at Zhenfo Mountain are located on Zhenfo Mountain, south of Qinghe Village, Fushan Township, Da County, Dazhou City, Sichuan. This is a rare group of temple buildings integrating Confucianism, Buddhism, and Daoism as one. The group of temples, completed in the 18th year of Daoguang (1838), has undergone multiple renovations before and after; the temple buildings are well preserved, and in 1981 were listed among provincial cultural relic protection units; now they are the 7th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units. The Temples at Zhenfo Mountain are built according to the mountain terrain on a high mountain at an altitude of 710m, contrasting delightfully with the surrounding lush forests. The total site area of the temple group is 40,000 sq m, among which the building area is 15,000 sq m, with a large scale; all are traditional siheyuan layouts, spreading along the continuous mountain terrain straight to the towering mountain top. From the foot of the mountain to the mountain gate there are a total of 1,179 stone steps; upward from the mountain gate are sequentially the theater tower, Heavenly Kings Hall, Son of Heaven Hall, Dehua Temple, Mahavira Hall, and other buildings; the buildings were mostly renovated in recent years, adopting Qing dynasty architectural styles, with few ancient relics. Although the ancient style is no longer, being in the green mountain and Buddhist temple, watching the curling clouds and smoke, listening to the melodious bell, and smelling the faint incense, one feels as if placed outside the world, with quite a sense of transcending the mundane.

projects.name: 开江牌坊
projects.address: 达州市开江县任市镇街口
projects.content_zh: 位于达州市开江县的开江牌坊，融会清代绘画、雕刻、制陶等技艺与一身，是开江县最为重要的文物建筑之一。今天所称的开江牌坊包括任市镇牌坊和甘棠镇牌坊，其中任市镇牌坊位列1991年第三批省级保护单位之中。开江牌坊于2006年被评为全国重点文物保护单位。任市镇牌坊位于开江县城南的任市镇街口，是为清代官员张九封的妻子刘氏、姜妾氏所立。牌坊坐南朝北，设有三道拱门。最为独特的是，任市镇牌坊上镶嵌有数十处陶雕，刻有人物、花鸟、题字等不同主题，雕刻精美，细节丰富，栩栩如生，展现出极高的雕刻与制陶技艺。虽然历经百年风雨，这些陶艺雕绘仍然保存完好，清晰可辨。甘棠镇牌坊位于开江县甘棠乡五幅桥村雷家坡的庭院旁，是清宣宗道光二十四年(1844年)为清代胡的妻子胡氏立的。甘棠镇牌坊为东西走向，正中间明间为拱门，次间为方形门洞。明间檐下刻有圣旨二字，其下有坤维正气柏节松龄两块匾额分置两面。牌坊上另有龙凤呈祥琼楼玉宇等精美的浮雕，看上去十分华丽。两座开江牌坊均保存完好，充分展现了清末开江地区的建筑工艺水准与独特之处。
projects.content_en: The Kaijiang Memorial Archway, located in Kaijiang County, Dazhou City, integrates Qing dynasty painting, carving, pottery-making and other skills as one, and is one of the most important cultural relic buildings in Kaijiang County. The Kaijiang Memorial Archway referred to today includes the archway at Renshi Town and the archway at Gantang Town; among them, the archway at Renshi Town was listed in the 3rd batch of provincial protection units in 1991. The Kaijiang Memorial Archway was rated as a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit in 2006. The archway at Renshi Town is located at the street entrance of Renshi Town, south of Kaijiang County town, and was erected for Liu Shi and Jiang Qieshi, the wives of the Qing official Zhang Jiufeng. The archway faces south, with three arched doors. The most unique is that on the archway at Renshi Town there are inlaid dozens of pottery carvings, engraved with different themes such as figures, flowers and birds, and inscriptions, with exquisite carving, rich details, and lifelike appearance, showing extremely high carving and pottery-making skills. Although having experienced a hundred years of wind and rain, these pottery art carvings and paintings are still well preserved, clearly distinguishable. The archway at Gantang Town is located beside the courtyard at Leijiapo, Wufuqiao Village, Gantang Township, Kaijiang County, and was erected in the 24th year of Daoguang of Emperor Xuanzong of Qing (1844) for Hu Shi, the wife of Hu of Qing. The archway at Gantang Town runs east-west; the central mingjian is an arched door, and the secondary jian are square door openings. Under the eave of the mingjian there are engraved the two characters Imperial Decree, below which there are two plaques of Kunwei Zhengqi and Bojie Songling placed on both sides. On the archway there are additionally exquisite reliefs such as Dragon and Phoenix Presenting Auspiciousness and Jade Towers and Jade Pavilions, looking very gorgeous. Both Kaijiang Memorial Archways are well preserved, fully showing the architectural craft level and unique features of the Kaijiang area in late Qing.

projects.name: 渠县文庙
projects.name_en: Temple of Confucius in Qu County
projects.address: 达州市渠县县城
projects.content_zh: 渠县文庙位于四川省达州市渠县的县城内。渠县历代文风昌盛，早在宋朝之前就建有文庙来供奉孔子，现存的文庙是清嘉庆二十五年(1820年)动工重修的，工程前后历时150多年才竣工，并于2013年入选为第七批全国重点文物保护单位。渠县文庙布局完整，气势宏大。一进文庙，就被朱红甬壁所吸引，甬壁正反都书有宫墙万仞，相传是康熙帝的手书。甬壁之后是半月形的泮池，池上悬有三座石桥，有两条精雕的蟠龙卧于中桥的两头，甚是气派。桥的尽端引向一座高大的牌坊——棂星门。棂星门之后是供奉孔子的大成殿，大成殿内庄严肃穆，孔子主体立于大成殿正中，左右各卧龙相伴，上方悬有万世师表的匾额。见贤思齐焉，见不贤而内自省也，在供奉孔子的文庙中吟诵论语，如同穿越到春秋时期，成为孔子三千弟子之一，实现自己求学于仲尼的梦想。
projects.content_en: The Temple of Confucius in Qu County is located in the county town of Qu County, Dazhou City, Sichuan Province. Qu County has had a flourishing literary style throughout the dynasties; as early as before the Song dynasty, a Confucian temple was built to enshrine Confucius. The existing Confucian temple was started to be rebuilt in the 25th year of Jiaqing (1820), Qing; the project took over 150 years before and after to be completed, and in 2013 was selected as the 7th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units. The Temple of Confucius in Qu County has a complete layout and grand momentum. Upon entering the Confucian temple, one is attracted by the vermilion corridor wall; on both the front and back of the corridor wall there are written the four characters Palace Wall Ten Thousand Ren, said to be the handwriting of the Kangxi Emperor. Behind the corridor wall is the crescent-shaped Pan Pool; above the pool there hang three stone bridges, with two exquisitely carved coiling dragons lying at both ends of the middle bridge, very imposing. The end of the bridge leads to a tall archway — the Lingxing Gate. Behind the Lingxing Gate is the Dacheng Hall enshrining Confucius; inside the Dacheng Hall it is solemn and majestic; the main body of Confucius stands in the center of the Dacheng Hall, accompanied by coiling dragons on the left and right, and above hangs the plaque of Teacher of Ten Thousand Generations. When seeing virtue, think of equaling it; when seeing un-virtue, examine yourself internally — reciting the Analects in the Confucian temple enshrining Confucius is like traveling back to the Spring and Autumn period, becoming one of Confucius's three thousand disciples, and realizing one's dream of studying under Zhongni.

projects.name: 冯焕阙
projects.address: 达州市渠县北土溪镇汉阙村
projects.content_zh: 冯焕阙位于渠县北土溪镇汉阙村(原名赵家坪)，距离渠县土溪火车站约为10公里，始建于东汉建光元年(121年)或建光二年，是为东汉幽州刺史冯焕平冤而设。冯焕阙的阙身挺拔，风格朴素稳重，充分展现了四川汉阙精致简练、稳重优雅的艺术特征。早在1961年，冯焕阙就被列入国务院批准的第一批全国重点文物保护单位。在农田之中，一眼即可见安详矗立在围墙院落中高耸的冯焕阙。这是一座完整的仿木石构，阙高4.38米，宽约0.8米，由六个部分组成，分别是阙顶、斗拱层、介石、枋子层、阙身、阙基。下部平直厚重，无多余雕饰，上刻铭文：故尚书侍郎河南京令豫州幽州刺史冯使君道，告知此阙身世。铭文书法遒劲张扬，是汉代书法遗存中的瑰宝，还被收入北宋李清照、赵明诚的著作《金石录》当中。冯焕阙上部则丰富精细，由三层青石堆叠而成，配有青龙、玄武等精细浮雕。阙顶为双层檐，上覆瓦，有草叶纹饰，很是细腻。凝视着这经受两千多年沧桑仍保持着朴实素净而又优雅超凡的汉阙，一种历史的厚重感油然而生。
projects.content_en: Feng Huan Tower is located in Hanque Village (formerly Zhaojiaping), Tuxi Town, north of Qu County, about 10km from the Tuxi Railway Station of Qu County. It was first built in the 1st year of Jianguang (121) or the 2nd year of Jianguang of Eastern Han, and was erected to redress the injustice of Feng Huan, the Inspector of Youzhou in Eastern Han. The tower body of Feng Huan Tower is tall and straight, with a simple and steady style, fully showing the exquisite, concise, steady, and elegant artistic characteristics of Sichuan Han towers. As early as 1961, Feng Huan Tower was listed in the first batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units approved by the State Council. In the farmland, at a glance one can see Feng Huan Tower towering and peacefully standing in the walled courtyard. This is a complete imitation-timber stone structure; the tower is 4.38m high and about 0.8m wide, composed of six parts, respectively the tower top, bracket-set layer, intermediate stone, lintel layer, tower body, and tower base. The lower part is straight and heavy, without redundant carvings and decorations; on it is engraved the inscription: Former Shangshu Shilang, Henan Jingling, Yuzhou Youzhou Cishi Feng Shijun Dao, informing the origin of this tower. The inscription calligraphy is vigorous and flamboyant, a treasure among Han dynasty calligraphy remains, and was also included in the work Jinshi Lu (Records of Metal and Stone) by Li Qingzhao and Zhao Mingcheng of Northern Song. The upper part of Feng Huan Tower is rich and delicate, stacked from three layers of bluestone, equipped with fine reliefs such as Azure Dragon and Black Tortoise. The tower top is a double eave, covered with tiles, with grass-leaf patterns, very delicate. Gazing at this Han tower that, after over two thousand years of vicissitudes, still maintains simplicity, purity, elegance, and transcendence, a sense of historical heaviness arises spontaneously.

projects.name: 渠县汉阙
projects.name_en: Stone Towers of the Han Dynasty in Qu County
projects.address: 达州市渠县
projects.content_zh: 汉晋两朝，渠县为四川东部的政治中心，因而其留存着较多珍贵精美的汉阙，闻名全国，被称为中国汉阙之乡。除了进入首批全国重点文物保护单位的冯焕阙与沈府君阙以外，阙身无铭文的蒲家湾汉阙、赵家村汉阙、王家坪汉阙也进入了第五批全国重点文物保护单位，它们与冯焕阙、沈府君阙一起，合称渠县汉阙。距沈府君阙不远，沿着乡间新铺的水泥路一路向前，便可到达蒲家湾无铭阙，这是一处位于堰塘旁边的汉阙，没有围墙保护，显得单薄而沧桑。蒲家湾无铭阙本为双阙，但可惜西侧已毁，现仅存东侧主阙，上雕朱雀、青龙、花草、玉兔等图饰。赵家村东无铭阙与赵家村西无铭阙均位于赵家村，此二阙原均为双阙，但均被毁坏而仅剩一阙。赵家村东无铭阙仅存东阙，上雕朱雀，内刻青龙，下饰玄武，阙背雕刻狩猎图样，雕刻技艺精妙异常。赵家村西无铭阙仅存西阙，造型同赵家村东无铭阙，与冯焕阙为邻，阙背雕刻有人物图案，惟妙惟肖。王家坪无铭阙位于冯焕阙与沈府君阙之间，也为双阙结构，但仅存东阙主阙。王家坪无铭阙正面也无铭文，施以朱雀、青龙、异兽等雕刻，阙背有人物、玉兔等浮雕图景，栩栩如生，别具一格。
projects.content_en: During the Han and Jin dynasties, Qu County was the political center of eastern Sichuan, hence it retains more precious and exquisite Han towers, famous nationwide, and is called the Hometown of Han Towers in China. Besides Feng Huan Tower and Shen Fujun Tower which entered the first batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units, the Pujiawan Han Tower, Zhaojiacun Han Tower, and Wangjiaping Han Tower, whose tower bodies have no inscriptions, also entered the 5th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units; together with Feng Huan Tower and Shen Fujun Tower, they are collectively called the Stone Towers of the Han Dynasty in Qu County. Not far from Shen Fujun Tower, walking forward along the newly paved cement road in the countryside, one can reach the Pujiawan Uninscribed Tower; this is a Han tower located beside a pond, without wall protection, appearing thin and weathered. The Pujiawan Uninscribed Tower was originally a double tower, but unfortunately the west side has been destroyed, and now only the east main tower survives, on which are carved decorative patterns such as Vermilion Bird, Azure Dragon, flowers and plants, and Jade Rabbit. Both the East Zhaojiacun Uninscribed Tower and the West Zhaojiacun Uninscribed Tower are located in Zhaojiacun; these two towers were originally both double towers, but both were destroyed leaving only one tower. The East Zhaojiacun Uninscribed Tower only has the east tower surviving, on which is carved the Vermilion Bird, inside is engraved the Azure Dragon, below is decorated with the Black Tortoise, and on the back of the tower is carved a hunting pattern, with extremely exquisite carving skills. The West Zhaojiacun Uninscribed Tower only has the west tower surviving, with the same shape as the East Zhaojiacun Uninscribed Tower, adjacent to Feng Huan Tower; on the back of the tower there are carved figure patterns, lifelike. The Wangjiaping Uninscribed Tower is located between Feng Huan Tower and Shen Fujun Tower, also a double-tower structure, but only the east main tower survives. The front of the Wangjiaping Uninscribed Tower also has no inscription, with carvings such as Vermilion Bird, Azure Dragon, and exotic beasts; on the back of the tower there are relief scenes such as figures and Jade Rabbit, lifelike and unique.

projects.name: 沈府君阙
projects.address: 达州市渠县水口乡汉亭村燕家场
projects.content_zh: 沈府君阙位于渠县水口乡汉亭村燕家场，与冯焕阙的距离并不太远。沈府君阙始建于东汉延光年间(122—125年)，雕刻精巧，造型古朴，为现今汉阙中仅存的双阙结构，因而被收入为第一批全国重点文物保护单位。我们到的时候，只见沈府君阙被水磨围墙所围，围墙上的大门也上了锁，因而我们只能在围墙外瞻仰这一汉代瑰宝。沈府君阙为东西双阙，两阙相距21.62米，大小相仿，均高4.82米，宽0.98米，厚0.66米，子阙均已损毁，仅余母阙。两阙正面分别刻有汉谒者北屯司马左都侯沈府君神道以及汉新丰令交趾都尉沈府君神道的汉隶铭文，铭文四周以朱雀、饕餮、青龙、白虎所环绕，雕刻精美。两阙阙身的内侧雕刻有所不同，东阙上雕青龙，似腾云之状，西阙则为白虎，做前扑之势。两阙还有农业生产、商业活动、神话传说等各式雕刻，内容丰富，极富趣味。沈府君阙因其完好的双阙形制，成为我国汉阙建筑中的精品。
projects.content_en: Shen Fujun Tower is located at Yanchangchang, Hanting Village, Shuikou Township, Qu County, not too far from Feng Huan Tower. Shen Fujun Tower was first built during the Eastern Han Yanguang era (122-125), with exquisite carving and simple and ancient shape; it is the only surviving double-tower structure among current Han towers, hence it was included as the first batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units. When we arrived, we saw that Shen Fujun Tower was surrounded by a water-milled wall, and the gate on the wall was also locked, so we could only look up at this Han dynasty treasure from outside the wall. Shen Fujun Tower is an east-west double tower; the two towers are 21.62m apart, similar in size, both 4.82m high, 0.98m wide, and 0.66m thick; the sub-towers have all been damaged, leaving only the main towers. On the front of the two towers there are respectively engraved Han clerical inscriptions of Spirit Path of Shen Fujun, Han Yezhe Beitun Sima Zuo Duhou, and Spirit Path of Shen Fujun, Han Xinfeng Ling Jiaozhi Duwei; around the inscriptions are surrounded by Vermilion Bird, Taotie, Azure Dragon, and White Tiger, with exquisite carving. The inner side carvings of the two tower bodies are different; on the east tower there is carved an Azure Dragon, seemingly in a cloud-soaring state, while the west tower is a White Tiger, in a forward-pouncing posture. The two towers also have various carvings such as agricultural production, commercial activities, and myths and legends, with rich content and great interest. Due to its intact double-tower form, Shen Fujun Tower has become a fine example among China's Han tower architecture.

projects.name: 南龛摩崖造像
projects.address: 巴中市南龛山
projects.content_zh: 南龛摩崖造像位于四川省巴中市，始建于隋唐，是巴中地区保存最完整、最集中的造像，于1988年由国务院列为全国重点文物保护单位。坐落于南龛山上的南龛石窟，历经隋唐以来数代打造，现有石窟174龛、2000余尊保存完好的造像、4则新建碑、10则造像碑、14座经幢、一幅严武(唐巴州牧)的奏表碑、52首诗文、52条题记。南龛石窟里的造像各个匠心独运、栩栩如生，当中有气质浑厚的天王、神态庄严的佛像、体态优美的飞天、神情潇洒的伎乐等，极为珍贵。
projects.content_en: The Cliffside Statues of Nankan are located in Bazhong City, Sichuan Province. They were first built in Sui-Tang, and are the most completely preserved and most concentrated statues in the Bazhong area; in 1988 they were listed by the State Council as a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit. The Nankan Grottoes, located on Nankan Mountain, have been created through generations since Sui-Tang; currently there are 174 niches, over 2,000 well-preserved statues, 4 new steles, 10 statue steles, 14 scripture pillars, one memorial stele of Yan Wu (Tang Bazhou Governor), 52 poems, and 52 inscriptions. The statues in the Nankan Grottoes are each ingeniously designed and lifelike; among them there are heavenly kings with vigorous temperament, Buddha statues with solemn expressions, flying apsaras with graceful postures, and musicians with elegant expressions, etc., extremely precious.

projects.name: 水宁寺摩崖造像
projects.address: 巴中市巴州区清江镇
projects.content_zh: 水宁寺摩崖造像位于巴中市巴州区水宁寺镇，现存佛教造像300余尊，是唐代摩崖石刻的典型代表，于2001年与南龛摩崖造像合并为全国第五批重点文物保护单位。水宁寺的摩崖造像多为盛唐时期造刻，也有少数的晚唐作品。主要的内容有药师三尊变释迦说法像等佛教题材。这些造像体现出典型的唐代造像特征，体态丰腴，形象端庄。佛像安详，力士勇猛，飞天、侍者、佛龛供养人等则展现出各异的神态与肢体语言，形象生动，令人惊异于唐代造像的高超造诣。川渝地区唐代摩崖造像留存较多，是我国古代文化艺术史上的精品，水宁寺造像虽不甚知名，但其历史价值却不容小觑。
projects.content_en: The Cliffside Statues of Shuining Temple are located in Shuining Temple Town, Bazhou District, Bazhong City. Currently there are over 300 surviving Buddhist statues, a typical representative of Tang dynasty cliffside stone carvings; in 2001 they were merged with the Cliffside Statues of Nankan as the 5th batch of National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units. Most of the cliffside statues of Shuining Temple were carved during the High Tang period, with a few works from the late Tang. The main contents include Buddhist themes such as the Triad of Medicine Master and the Shakyamuni Preaching Dharma Statue. These statues reflect typical Tang dynasty statue characteristics, with plump postures and dignified images. The Buddha statues are serene, the guardian warriors are fierce, and the flying apsaras, attendants, and niche donors show various expressions and body language, with vivid images, making one marvel at the superb attainment of Tang dynasty statue carving. The Tang dynasty cliffside statues in the Sichuan-Chongqing region have survived in relatively large numbers, and are fine works in the history of ancient Chinese cultural art; although the Shuining Temple statues are not very well known, their historical value should not be underestimated.

projects.name: 白石寺
projects.address: 巴中市通江县文胜乡白石寺村
projects.content_zh: 白石寺位于四川省巴中市通江县文胜乡白石寺村的沙溪河旁，是一座典型的清代古寺。白石寺建筑的原有规模宏大，由前、中、后三殿组成，经过了数百年的历史风霜，现后殿已毁，仅存前殿和中殿两座古迹斑驳的单体建筑，分别建于清康熙五十五年(1716年)和清乾隆三十年(1771年)。白石寺现已被选入第八批四川省重点文物保护单位。白石寺的建筑格局为轴对称形式，前殿和中殿依次沿着中轴线呈对称分布。白石寺的前殿和中殿的名称分别为佛爷殿和老君殿，大殿的主体虽已残破不堪，但其粗大高耸的立柱仍屹立不倒，可见当初建造时所用木料之上乘。此外，殿中还留存有精美的构件镂空雕刻，饰有花鸟图案，显示着设计修建工匠的高超技艺。房屋与雕饰精美协调的布局，不得不令人赞叹。
projects.content_en: Baishi (White Stone) Temple is located beside the Shaxi River in Baishisi Village, Wensheng Township, Tongjiang County, Bazhong City, Sichuan Province. It is a typical Qing dynasty ancient temple. The original scale of the Baishi Temple building was grand, composed of front, middle, and rear halls; after hundreds of years of historical vicissitudes, the rear hall has now been destroyed, and only two weathered single buildings, the front hall and middle hall, survive, respectively built in the 55th year of Kangxi (1716) and the 30th year of Qianlong (1771), Qing. Baishi Temple has now been selected into the 8th batch of Sichuan Provincial Key Cultural Relics Protection Units. The architectural layout of Baishi Temple is in an axisymmetric form; the front hall and middle hall are sequentially distributed symmetrically along the central axis. The names of the front hall and middle hall of Baishi Temple are respectively the Buddha Hall and the Laojun Hall; although the main body of the main hall is already in ruins, its thick and towering columns still stand firm, showing the high quality of the timber used in the original construction. In addition, exquisite component openwork carvings remain in the hall, decorated with flower and bird patterns, showing the superb skills of the design and construction craftsmen. The exquisite and coordinated layout of the houses and carvings has to be admired.

projects.name: 鲁班寺
projects.address: 巴中市通江县诺水河镇鲁坝村
projects.content_zh: 鲁班寺位于巴中市通江县诺水河镇鲁坝村长滩河旁，坐落在环境优美的诺水河国家级风景名胜区中。鲁班寺始建于明末，后于清朝进行重修，建筑格局保存相对完好，现被收入四川省重点文物保护单位。鲁班寺的建筑格局为对称院落形式，现留存有较为完整的前殿、正殿与左右厢房。建筑的外墙虽已剥落，但内部的建筑结构却保存得较为完好，是研究明末清初建筑风格艺术不可多得的艺术珍品。大殿的建筑风格较为质朴，飘逸的飞檐与青瓦之上并无更多点缀。但殿内留存着精美的镂空花窗和纹刻梁柱，绘有祥云、花叶等图案，可以依稀想见，鲁班寺建成之初大殿内部雕梁画栋的精美景象。可惜岁月流逝，时光的剥蚀使得这里层层积灰，孤寂异常。
projects.content_en: Luban Temple is located beside Changtan River, Luba Village, Nuoshuihe Town, Tongjiang County, Bazhong City, situated in the beautifully landscaped Nuoshui River National Scenic Area. Luban Temple was first built in the late Ming, later rebuilt in Qing dynasty; its architectural layout is relatively well preserved, and is now included in the Sichuan Provincial Key Cultural Relics Protection Units. The architectural layout of Luban Temple is in a symmetrical courtyard form; currently there survive relatively complete front hall, main hall, and left and right wing rooms. Although the outer walls of the building have peeled off, the internal building structure is relatively well preserved, and is a rare artistic treasure for studying the architectural style and art of the late Ming and early Qing. The architectural style of the main hall is relatively simple, with no more decorations on the elegant flying eaves and grey tiles. But inside the hall there remain exquisite hollowed-out flower windows and carved beam columns, painted with patterns such as auspicious clouds and flower leaves; one can vaguely imagine the exquisite scene of carved beams and painted pillars inside the main hall when Luban Temple was first completed. Unfortunately, as time passes, the erosion of time has made layers of dust accumulate here, extremely lonely.

projects.name: 燊海井
projects.address: 自贡市大安区长堰塘旁
projects.highlights: 千米盐井、天车、井盐生产、大木结构
projects.content_zh: 自贡市素以盐之都、龙之乡、灯之城的美誉而闻名于世。其中，最让人印象深刻的便是其独特的井盐文化了，而燊海井便是其典型代表。燊海井位于自贡市大安区长堰塘旁，占地面积约为3亩(1亩约等于666.7平方米)，井位海拔约为341.4米，井深约为1001.42米，是世界上第一口超过千米的深井。燊海井历时13年于道光十五年(1835年)得以竣工，它曾经是一口卤气同采的高产井，至今仍在生产井盐。自贡也因为其鼎盛的盐业成为中国井矿盐中心。靠近燊海井，立即映入眼帘的便是称为天车的木质建筑，实为井架。由竹篾将圆木紧紧捆绑而成的天车高高耸立在井边，远远望去颇具汉字中人的形象。作为自贡市的标志性建筑之一，古老而沧桑的天车，像一位长者一样，注视着他所钟爱的城市的发展变化，见证着自贡井盐文化的发展壮大。由于盐卤长年累月的浸泡、沉淀，井口周围已经腐蚀、发黄，俨然斑斑岁月的痕迹。盐卤便是通过器皿深入井口，从这千米之下打捞而出。由于没有机械的帮助，打捞卤水全靠原始木质器械完成。这便是其中最重要的工具——大车，它利用木块和粗绳搭建捆绑而成，具有转动灵活、牵引力大等特点。正因为其独创性与代表性，燊海井于1988年正式被入全国重点保护文物；自贡传统采盐技术也是国家非物质文化遗产中的重要一员。
projects.content_en: Zigong City is world-famous for its reputation as the Capital of Salt, Hometown of Dinosaurs, and City of Lanterns. Among them, the most impressive is its unique well-salt culture, and Shenhai Well is its typical representative. Shenhai Well is located beside Changyantang, Da'an District, Zigong City, covering an area of about 3 mu (1 mu ≈ 666.7 sq m); the well site is at an altitude of about 341.4m, and the well depth is about 1,001.42m — it is the first deep well in the world to exceed one thousand meters. Shenhai Well took 13 years to be completed in the 15th year of Daoguang (1835); it was once a high-yield well extracting both brine and gas, and is still producing well salt to this day. Zigong also became the center of China's well and rock salt due to its prosperous salt industry. Approaching Shenhai Well, what immediately comes into view is the timber building called the Heavenly Cart, actually a well derrick. The Heavenly Cart, tightly bound from round logs by bamboo strips, stands tall beside the well; from afar it quite resembles the Chinese character for person (人). As one of the landmark buildings of Zigong City, the ancient and weathered Heavenly Cart, like an elder, watches the development and changes of the city he loves, witnessing the development and growth of Zigong's well-salt culture. Due to years of soaking and precipitation by salt brine, the area around the well mouth has corroded and turned yellow, clearly showing traces of time. Salt brine is retrieved by inserting vessels deep into the well mouth, hauled up from a thousand meters below. Without the help of machinery, hauling brine relies entirely on primitive timber instruments. This is the most important tool among them — the Great Cart; it is built and bound from wood blocks and thick ropes, with features such as flexible rotation and large traction. Precisely because of its originality and representativeness, Shenhai Well was officially listed as a National Key Protected Cultural Relic in 1988; Zigong's traditional salt-extraction technology is also an important member of the national intangible cultural heritage.

projects.name: 自贡桓侯宫
projects.address: 自贡市自流井区新民街与中华路口交界处
projects.highlights: 布局、结构、桓侯宫门、戏楼、正殿
projects.content_zh: 位于四川省自贡市自流井区的桓侯宫，始建于清代乾隆年间，于同治四年至光绪元年(1865—1875年)原址复建，2013年被列入全国重点文物保护单位。建在小山坡上的桓侯宫，整个建筑群看起来气势磅礴，宏伟壮观。靠近桓侯宫，映入眼帘的是其庄严肃穆的大门。面阔三间20.6米，高14.2米，正楼檐下竖匾为桓侯宫，山门屹立着弧形封火墙，瞬间给桓侯宫增添一种古老而神秘的色彩。特别值得一提的是，桓侯宫的雕刻巧夺天工。不仅由于其保存完好，更由于其刻艺精湛，使得桓侯宫中无论是石雕还是木雕，都显得其雕刻艺术登峰造极，从进门两边的门墩就可见一斑。这一对石雕，左为龙，右为凤，活灵活现，栩栩如生。仔细观察这些雕刻，纹路清晰，刀法细腻，宛如行云流水，游刃有余。进入桓侯宫，在门厅之上的建筑，称为戏楼。拾级而上便是正殿，面阔三间13.55米，进深四间21.15米，高13.82米，歇山顶，穿斗式梁架。这里的戏台、正殿、钟鼓楼等建筑，与大多数古代建筑相去不远，但是能够在建筑面积并不大的桓侯宫内井然有序地布置这样的建筑格局而不产生拥挤之感，确实让人对建筑师的高超能力拍案叫绝。
projects.content_en: Huanhou Hall, located in Ziliujing District, Zigong City, Sichuan Province, was first built during the Qing Qianlong era, rebuilt on the original site from the 4th year of Tongzhi to the 1st year of Guangxu (1865-1875), and was listed as a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit in 2013. Huanhou Hall, built on a small hillside, has an entire building complex that looks majestic and spectacular. Approaching Huanhou Hall, what comes into view is its solemn and majestic gate. It is 3 bays wide (20.6m) and 14.2m high; under the eave of the main tower there is a vertical plaque reading Huanhou Hall; the mountain gate stands with an arc-shaped fire-sealing wall, instantly adding an ancient and mysterious color to Huanhou Hall. Particularly worth mentioning is that the carvings of Huanhou Hall are a marvel of craftsmanship. Not only because it is well preserved, but even more because of its exquisite carving skills, making both stone carvings and wood carvings in Huanhou Hall appear to have reached the peak of carving art — this can be seen from the door piers on both sides of the entrance. This pair of stone carvings, with a dragon on the left and a phoenix on the right, are vivid and lifelike. Carefully observing these carvings, the lines are clear and the knife technique is delicate, like flowing clouds and running water, with effortless mastery. Entering Huanhou Hall, the building above the entrance hall is called the theater tower. Ascending the steps is the main hall, 3 bays wide (13.55m), 4 bays deep (21.15m), 13.82m high, with xieshan roof and chuan-dou beam frame. The buildings here, such as the stage, main hall, and bell and drum towers, are not far from most ancient buildings; but being able to orderly arrange such a building layout within Huanhou Hall, whose building area is not large, without creating a sense of crowding, truly makes one marvel at the superb ability of the architect.

projects.name: 西秦会馆
projects.address: 自贡市自流井区解放路107号
projects.highlights: 布局、武圣宫大门、戏楼、院落
projects.content_zh: 位于自贡市自流井区解放路的西秦会馆，坐落在风景秀美的龙凤山下，后靠自贡市的母亲河——釜溪河，巍然耸立，庄重不凡。该馆原是清代陕西盐商为了联络议事等而修建的会馆，故称西秦会馆；又因为馆内供奉关羽像，也被称为关帝庙。1988年被列为全国重点文物保护单位，后设有自贡市盐业历史博物馆。会馆始建于清乾隆元年(1736年)，于道光七至九年(1827—1828年)大规模扩建并维修，新中国成立后曾几度维修，目前为三进四合院布局，坐南向北，占地面积3451平方米，建筑面积约3000平方米。主要建筑有武圣宫大门、献技楼、大观楼、福海楼、抱厅、参天阁、中殿、正殿等。武圣宫大门高大威武、庄严肃穆，大门上金色图案和各种精美的雕刻，十分夺目。门前的石狮排列整齐、对立而视，表情自然而又生动，身姿挺拔，形象威猛。门后殿阔四间32.85米，进深8.1米，高16.8米，重檐歇山顶，穿斗式梁架。除了武圣宫之外，戏楼、中殿、正殿等依次排列在会馆中轴线上，随地形变化有所起伏，标高变化丰富。整体看来西秦会馆内各建筑造型典雅、别致，相互之间采用布局均衡，园林式的整体呈现出一种有机的凝聚感。殿内各处的彩绘、泥塑以及木雕石雕向人们讲述着从神话到历史中各种各样的民俗故事，令人流连忘返。这俨然就是一幅绝美的园林画卷。
projects.content_en: The Xi qin (Western Shaanxi) Guild Hall, located on Jiefang Road, Ziliujing District, Zigong City, is situated at the foot of the scenic Longfeng Mountain, backed by the mother river of Zigong City — the Fuxi River, towering majestically and solemnly. This hall was originally a guild hall built by Shaanxi salt merchants in Qing dynasty for liaison and discussion, hence called Xi qin Guild Hall; also because a statue of Guan Yu is enshrined inside the hall, it is also called the Guandi Temple. In 1988 it was listed as a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit, and later the Zigong Salt Industry History Museum was established. The guild hall was first built in the 1st year of Qianlong (1736), Qing, and underwent large-scale expansion and maintenance from the 7th to 9th year of Daoguang (1827-1828); after the founding of New China it was repaired several times. Currently it has a three-courtyard siheyuan layout, facing north, covering 3,451 sq m, with a building area of about 3,000 sq m. The main buildings include the Wusheng Palace Gate, Performance Tower, Daguan Tower, Fuhai Tower, Embracing Hall, Cantian Pavilion, Middle Hall, Main Hall, etc. The Wusheng Palace Gate is tall and mighty, solemn and majestic; the golden patterns and various exquisite carvings on the gate are very eye-catching. The stone lions in front of the gate are neatly arranged, facing each other, with natural and vivid expressions, upright postures, and fierce images. Behind the gate, the hall is 4 bays wide (32.85m), 8.1m deep, 16.8m high, with double-eave xieshan roof and chuan-dou beam frame. Besides the Wusheng Palace, the theater tower, middle hall, main hall, etc. are sequentially arranged on the central axis of the guild hall, undulating with terrain changes, with rich elevation changes. Overall, each building in the Xi qin Guild Hall has an elegant and unique shape; they adopt a balanced layout among each other, and the garden-style whole presents an organic sense of cohesion. The colored paintings, clay sculptures, and wood and stone carvings everywhere in the halls tell people various folk stories from mythology to history, making people linger and forget to return. This is simply a beautiful garden painting scroll.

projects.name: 王爷庙
projects.address: 自贡市自流井区釜溪河畔
projects.content_zh: 自贡市素以盐之都著称，自清道光、咸丰年间，自流井地区已然发展形成了四川省的主要盐场。为了紧锁财源，当时信奉风水的盐商巨贾们于同治年间在釜溪河边建庙镇江，建成了如今的王爷庙。王爷庙坐落在釜溪河边，背倚龙凤山，与附近的西秦会馆、桓侯宫形成鼎立之势。远观王爷庙，一栋形态奇特的建筑傲然矗立，伴着粼粼波光，幽幽绿树，显得是那么恬静优雅，不像是坐落在市中心的古建筑，仿佛超脱喧闹，自然和谐。靠近王爷庙，浓浓的古色古香的氛围便扑面而来。庙墙以砖红色为主，点点绿叶红花探墙而出，美不胜收。王爷庙大门虽系后来重建，但大门匾额上书有王爷庙三个大字，仿佛也在含蓄地透露着其岁月的痕迹。王爷庙内的布局好似南方园林一般，这里绿树成荫，闲情惬意。配有假山、石桌等装饰，显得那么不拘一格，但又那么紧密配合。而王爷庙中最著名的要数那保存相当完好的清代川剧戏台。该戏台为抬梁式木结构，单檐歇山式屋顶，造型不仅典雅大方，色彩更加绚丽斑斓。据记载，王爷庙后因修建公路拆毁了部分建筑，因此余下且保存完好的戏楼便显得格外珍贵。特别值得一提的是，戏台之上的雕刻也十分精致，主题丰富，华丽精美。即使是岁月无情地冲刷，也不能掩盖这些雕刻所蕴含的极高的艺术价值和观赏价值。
projects.content_en: Zigong City is known as the Capital of Salt; since the Qing Daoguang and Xianfeng eras, the Ziliujing area had already developed into the main salt field of Sichuan Province. To lock in financial resources, the wealthy salt merchants who believed in fengshui at that time built a temple by the Fuxi River during the Tongzhi era to subdue the river, completing today's Wangye (River Lord) Shrine. Wangye Shrine is located by the Fuxi River, backed by Longfeng Mountain, forming a tripartite balance with the nearby Xi qin Guild Hall and Huanhou Hall. Viewing Wangye Shrine from afar, a building with a peculiar shape stands proudly, accompanied by glistening waves and serene green trees, appearing so tranquil and elegant, not like an ancient building located in the city center, as if transcending the noise, natural and harmonious. Approaching Wangye Shrine, a strong ancient and elegant atmosphere blows in. The temple walls are mainly brick-red, with dots of green leaves and red flowers peeking out over the wall, beautiful beyond description. Although the main gate of Wangye Shrine was rebuilt later, the plaque on the gate bears the three large characters Wangye Shrine, as if subtly revealing its traces of time. The layout inside Wangye Shrine is like a southern garden; here green trees form shade, with a leisurely and comfortable mood. Equipped with decorations such as rockeries and stone tables, it appears so unconventional, yet so closely coordinated. And the most famous in Wangye Shrine is the quite well-preserved Qing dynasty Sichuan opera stage. This stage is of post-and-lintel timber structure, with single-eave xieshan roof; its shape is not only elegant and graceful, but its colors are even more gorgeous and resplendent. According to records, Wangye Shrine later had part of its buildings demolished due to road construction, hence the remaining and well-preserved theater tower appears particularly precious. Particularly worth mentioning is that the carvings on the stage are also very exquisite, with rich themes, gorgeous and refined. Even the merciless erosion of time cannot conceal the extremely high artistic value and ornamental value contained in these carvings.

projects.name: 荣县镇南塔
projects.address: 自贡市荣县旭阳镇南
projects.content_zh: 位于四川省自贡市荣县旭阳镇南的镇南塔，始建于宋代，明清皆有重修。至今除了塔刹被毁之外，其余部分基本保存完好。镇南塔为方形11层楼阁砖石塔，通高23.85米，占地面积60.84平方米，巍然耸立，气势不凡。虽然由于岁月的冲刷使得塔身部分地方变黑，但通体仍为白色，当地人乐于称其为白塔而并非镇南塔。远观镇南塔，矗立在山巅的它犹如一股浩然正气凝视着山川大地。塔底树木环绕，绿树成荫，形态各异，美不胜收。仿佛是为了给白塔以碧绿的点缀，如诗如画，一点儿也不显得突兀，恰好形成了塔与自然融为一体的美妙感觉。此时白塔全貌尽入眼帘，若天公作美，雾气萦绕之时远眺白塔，此时的白塔在雾中若隐若现，配上点点碧绿，好似仙境一般。近观镇南塔，塔身逐层内收，各层均以壁柱做成四柱三间形态，模拟楼阁属性。除一层中部开有真假拱门之外，以上各层均有开窗，极为规整。塔内有中心塔柱，可沿蹬道绕柱而上，但今已封闭，未能登高望远，一览全城风景实为一憾。特别值得注意的是，镇南塔第五层塑有一僧人像，虽历经风蚀雨浸，但仍然形态完整，五官清晰。该僧人坐姿端正，目视前方，嘴角上扬，仿佛凝视着这苍茫大地，直面这沧海桑田。而这不也正是镇南塔所经历着的吗？
projects.content_en: Zhennan (South-Suppressing) Pagoda, located south of Xuyang Town, Rong County, Zigong City, Sichuan Province, was first built in Song dynasty, and was rebuilt in both Ming and Qing. To this day, except for the destroyed pagoda finial, the rest is basically well preserved. Zhennan Pagoda is a square 11-story pavilion-style brick-stone pagoda, with a total height of 23.85m, covering 60.84 sq m, towering majestically with extraordinary momentum. Although due to the erosion of time parts of the pagoda body have turned black, the whole body is still white; local people are pleased to call it the White Pagoda rather than Zhennan Pagoda. Viewing Zhennan Pagoda from afar, standing on the mountain top, it is like a stream of noble righteousness gazing at the mountains and rivers. At the bottom of the pagoda, trees surround it, with green trees forming shade, in various shapes, beautiful beyond description. As if to give the White Pagoda a verdant ornament, it is poetic and picturesque, not at all obtrusive,恰好 forming a wonderful feeling of the pagoda integrating with nature. At this time the full view of the White Pagoda comes into sight; if the weather is favorable, viewing the White Pagoda from afar when mist wraps around it, the White Pagoda at this time looms in and out of the mist, paired with dots of verdant green, like a fairyland. Viewing Zhennan Pagoda up close, the pagoda body tapers inward layer by layer; each layer uses wall columns to form a four-column three-bay shape, simulating the attributes of a pavilion. Except for the middle of the first layer which has real and fake arched doors, all layers above have windows opened, extremely regular. Inside the pagoda there is a central pagoda column, and one can climb along the stairway around the column, but it is now closed; being unable to climb high and look far, taking in the whole city scenery is truly a regret. Particularly noteworthy is that the fifth layer of Zhennan Pagoda has a statue of a monk; although experiencing wind erosion and rain immersion, it still has a complete form with clear facial features. The monk sits upright, gazing forward, with the corners of his mouth turned up, as if gazing at this vast land, facing this vicissitude of life. And isn't this exactly what Zhennan Pagoda has experienced?

projects.name: 荣县大佛石窟
projects.address: 自贡市荣县县城东郊大佛山山麓
projects.highlights: 大佛石窟、大雄禅寺、远瞻与近观
projects.content_zh: 荣县大佛坐落在四川省自贡市荣县城东郊大佛山山麓上，与乐山大佛相去不远但各有特点，故而有嘉州大佛雄，荣州大佛美的美誉。2006年被国务院列入全国重点文物保护单位。荣县大佛石窟始建于唐代，于山崖中凿窟成佛。佛像高36.67米，肩宽12.67米，据称是世界第一大释迦牟尼佛(现世佛)造像。佛像造型饱满，神情庄重，历经千年而保存完好，全面体现了唐代造像特征。荣县大佛所在庙宇，唐代时名为开化寺，后称为大佛禅寺。寺庙依山而建，因应山势，使得大佛石窟落在寺庙的中轴线上。从大佛寺中拾级而上，穿过重重殿宇，便能接近荣县大佛。这种将巨佛与建筑相互结合的做法，独具匠心，更是世间罕有。最靠近大佛的是大雄宝殿，不同于其他庙宇将佛像置于殿中的做法，这里佛像就是大佛本身，因此大雄宝殿也成为大佛殿。站在大佛前近观巨大佛足，经过近年改建，人们还可以攀登而上，在不同层高近距离观赏佛像，独特经历不禁令人叹为观止。
projects.content_en: The Rong County Great Buddha is located at the foot of Dafo (Great Buddha) Mountain, in the eastern suburbs of Rong County town, Zigong City, Sichuan Province. It is not far from the Leshan Great Buddha but each has its own characteristics, hence there is the reputation of the Great Buddha of Jiazhou being majestic and the Great Buddha of Rongzhou being beautiful. In 2006 it was listed by the State Council as a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit. The Rong County Great Buddha Grottoes were first built in Tang dynasty, with a cave chiseled in the cliff to form a Buddha. The Buddha statue is 36.67m high with a shoulder width of 12.67m; it is said to be the world's largest statue of Shakyamuni Buddha (the Buddha of the present world). The Buddha statue has a full shape and solemn expression, well preserved after a thousand years, fully reflecting the characteristics of Tang dynasty statue carving. The temple where the Rong County Great Buddha is located was named Kaihua Temple in Tang dynasty, later called Dafo Chan Temple. The temple was built according to the mountain, adapting to the mountain terrain, so that the Great Buddha Grotto falls on the central axis of the temple. Ascending the steps from within the Great Buddha Temple, passing through layers of halls, one can approach the Rong County Great Buddha. This method of combining the giant Buddha with architecture is ingenious and even more rare in the world. Closest to the Great Buddha is the Mahavira Hall; unlike other temples that place Buddha statues inside the hall, here the Buddha statue is the Great Buddha itself, hence the Mahavira Hall also becomes the Great Buddha Hall. Standing in front of the Great Buddha and closely viewing the giant Buddha feet, after recent renovations people can also climb up and view the Buddha statue at close range from different story heights — the unique experience cannot help but make one marvel.

projects.name: 富顺文庙
projects.address: 自贡市富顺县富世镇解放街大南门
projects.content_zh: 文庙亦称孔庙，是祭祀孔子的庙宇，在全国各地均有分布。我国保存完好的文庙为数不多，而坐落于四川省自贡市富顺县的富顺文庙，就是其中之一。富顺文庙始建于北宋庆历四年(1044年)，于2001年被国务院列为全国重点文物保护单位。富顺文人辈出，故而富顺文庙的显赫地位可见一斑。初见富顺文庙，一股历史的气息便扑面而来。虽说从棂星门中仿佛可以看到曲阜文庙的影子，但是它也有自己的特色。略带星色的红墙庄严肃穆，给文庙营造出一种神圣的氛围。棂星门上的石柱雕刻着数十条形态各异的龙，与刻有优雅文字的浮雕横匾相辅相成，细腻精致、美观大方，配上岁月所赋予的点点青苔，仿佛更加超凡脱俗、自然和谐。顺着棂星门向下看去便是泮池，泮池上有一座九龙桥。据说九龙桥是为状元准备的，因此其修建与雕刻的精细自然不言而喻。在青青的映衬下，桥上蜿蜒起伏的石龙愈加活灵活现、栩栩如生，一种敬畏之情油然而生。富顺文庙的大殿坐落于第二个院落，年久失修的大殿虽有些破败，但仍然可以看出其精美的雕刻与宏大的规模。
projects.content_en: The Confucian Temple, also called the Kong Temple, is a temple for sacrificing to Confucius, distributed throughout the country. There are not many well-preserved Confucian temples in China, and the Fushun Confucian Temple, located in Fushun County, Zigong City, Sichuan Province, is one of them. The Fushun Confucian Temple was first built in the 4th year of Qingli of Northern Song (1044), and was listed by the State Council as a National Key Cultural Relics Protection Unit in 2001. Fushun has produced many literati, hence the prominent status of the Fushun Confucian Temple is evident. At first sight of the Fushun Confucian Temple, a breath of history blows in. Although from the Lingxing Gate one can as if see the shadow of the Qufu Confucian Temple, it also has its own characteristics. The red walls, slightly tinged with star color, are solemn and majestic, creating a sacred atmosphere for the Confucian temple. The stone columns on the Lingxing Gate are carved with dozens of dragons in various shapes, complementing the relief horizontal plaques engraved with elegant text — delicate and exquisite, beautiful and graceful; paired with the dots of moss bestowed by time, it seems even more transcendent, natural, and harmonious. Looking down along the Lingxing Gate is the Pan Pool, and on the Pan Pool there is a Nine-Dragon Bridge. It is said that the Nine-Dragon Bridge was prepared for the top scholar, hence the fineness of its construction and carving is self-evident. Against the backdrop of green, the winding and undulating stone dragons on the bridge become even more vivid and lifelike, and a feeling of reverence arises spontaneously. The main hall of the Fushun Confucian Temple is located in the second courtyard; although the long-unrepaired main hall is somewhat dilapidated, one can still see its exquisite carvings and grand scale.

projects.name: 通远门
projects.address: 渝中区七星岗
projects.content_zh: 重庆城共有三次大规模修筑城墙的记载：公元前316年，为巩固秦朝统治，张仪在巴国国都江州(今重庆渝中半岛)始筑城墙；南宋时期蒙古南侵，彭大雅据半岛地势筑城，基本形成重庆古城墙格局；明太祖洪武四年(1371年)，戴鼎在旧址建成象征九宫八卦的九开八闭共十七座城门，关于这十七门还有这样一首民谣《重庆歌》：朝天门，大码头，迎官接圣。千厮门，花包子，白雪如银。洪崖门，广船开，杀鸡敬神。临江门，粪码头，肥田有本。定远门，较场坝，舞刀弄棍。通远门，锣鼓响，看埋死人。金汤门，木棺材，大小齐整。南纪门，菜篮子，涌出涌进。凤凰门，川道拐，牛羊成群。金紫门，恰对着，镇台衙门。储奇门，药材帮，医治百病。人和门，火炮响，总爷出巡。太平门，老鼓楼，时辰报准。太安门，太平仓，积谷利民。东水门，正对着，鲤跳龙门。翠微门，挂彩缎，五色鲜明。复兴门，溜跑马，快如腾云。可惜如今十七门中保存较好的只余两处，其一就是通远门。位于正西面的通远门是通往外地的陆路起点，出门向西即为佛图关，是通往四川成都的要道，故称通远。由于地处要道，通远门见证了多场惨烈的战事，张献忠围攻重庆那场最甚，由于死伤过多，使通远门外七星岗一带由此成为乱葬岗，遂有民谣中通远门，锣鼓响，看埋死人的说法。据史料记载，明末清初，张献忠率部60万，以10倍于守军的数量依然无法正面强攻，只能绕道江津从菜园坝登陆，夺取佛图关，卡死明军唯一退路，最后的主战场就在通远门。经过6天激战，张献忠派人掘开城外坟墓，取棺材板令士兵顶在头上以挡矢石，在城下挖地道埋火药，炸塌通远门转角城墙，方才攻入重庆。如今通远门遗址公园矗立着几组筑城、守城、攻城的铜雕，再现了当年那场激烈的战斗，也诉说着通远门城墙600多年的历史变迁与战乱动荡。通远门现存城墙及城门为明洪武年间遗址，城门为双拱形门洞，重庆特有的毛青条石砌墙，城门高5.33米，宽3.5米，厚7.41米。1929年，国民政府首任重庆市长潘文华授意凿穿通远门，600年不破的城墙终被打通，如今只余100米左右残存在城门两边，而原有瓮城更是早已全毁。以崖为墙，是通远门的雏形。通远门城墙整齐有序顺山崖而筑，居高临下，呈现出典型具有山地特色的古城墙。而随着城区扩展，通远门现在位于渝中主干道上，四条公路在这里交汇。每天车水马龙，人流不断，城上城下市井生活悠然自得。原来用作战事守卫的关隘如今成为人民安居乐业的场所，这座600多岁的古城墙，将继续守护着重庆城和重庆人。
projects.content_en: Chongqing City has records of three large-scale city wall constructions: in 316 BC, to consolidate Qin dynasty rule, Zhang Yi first built a city wall at Jiangzhou (today's Chongqing Yuzhong Peninsula), the capital of the Ba State; during the Southern Song period when the Mongols invaded southward, Peng Daya built a city wall according to the peninsula terrain, basically forming the layout of Chongqing's ancient city wall; in the 4th year of Hongwu of Ming Taizu (1371), Dai Ding built on the old site a total of seventeen city gates — nine open and eight closed — symbolizing the Nine Palaces and Eight Trigrams. About these seventeen gates there is such a folk ballad, the Chongqing Song: Chaotian Gate, great wharf, welcoming officials and receiving saints. Qiansi Gate, flower buns, white as snow. Hongya Gate, wide boats open, killing chickens to honor gods. Linjiang Gate, manure wharf, fertilizer has its source. Dingyuan Gate, drill ground, wielding swords and staffs. Tongyuan Gate, gongs and drums sound, watching the burial of the dead. Jintang Gate, wooden coffins, large and small all neat. Nanji Gate, vegetable baskets, surging in and out. Fenghuang Gate, Sichuan road bend, cattle and sheep in groups. Jinzi Gate, directly facing, the garrison commander's yamen. Chuqi Gate, medicine merchants, curing all diseases. Renhe Gate, cannons sound, the general goes on patrol. Taiping Gate, old drum tower, time reported accurately. Tai'an Gate, Taiping granary, storing grain for the people. Dongshui Gate, directly facing, carp leaping the dragon gate. Cuiwei Gate, hanging colored satin, five colors vivid. Fuxing Gate, galloping horses, fast as soaring clouds. Unfortunately, among the seventeen gates today only two remain relatively well preserved, one of which is Tongyuan Gate. Tongyuan Gate, located on the due west side, was the starting point of the land route leading to other places; going out westward was Fotu Pass, the main road leading to Chengdu, Sichuan, hence called Tongyuan (Leading Far). Because it was located on a main road, Tongyuan Gate witnessed many tragic battles; the siege of Chongqing by Zhang Xianzhong was the most severe. Due to excessive deaths, the area around Qixinggang outside Tongyuan Gate thus became a mass burial ground, hence the folk saying in the ballad: Tongyuan Gate, gongs and drums sound, watching the burial of the dead. According to historical records, at the end of Ming and beginning of Qing, Zhang Xianzhong led 600,000 troops, and with ten times the number of defenders still could not launch a frontal assault; he could only detour to Jiangjin and land from Caiyuanba, seize Fotu Pass, and cut off the only retreat route of the Ming army; the final main battlefield was at Tongyuan Gate. After six days of fierce fighting, Zhang Xianzhong sent people to dig open graves outside the city, took coffin boards and ordered soldiers to hold them over their heads to block arrows and stones, dug tunnels under the city to bury gunpowder, and blew up the corner city wall of Tongyuan Gate, only then entering Chongqing. Today, the Tongyuan Gate Ruins Park stands with several groups of bronze sculptures of city-building, city-defending, and city-attacking, recreating that fierce battle of those years, and also recounting the 600-plus years of historical changes and war turmoil of the Tongyuan Gate city wall. The existing city wall and gate of Tongyuan Gate are ruins from the Ming Hongwu period; the gate is a double-arch doorway, with Chongqing's unique rough bluestone dressed stones for the wall; the city gate is 5.33m high, 3.5m wide, and 7.41m thick. In 1929, Pan Wenhua, the first mayor of Chongqing under the Nationalist government, authorized the drilling through of Tongyuan Gate; the 600-year-unbroken city wall was finally breached. Today only about 100m remains on both sides of the gate, and the original barbican has long been completely destroyed. Using the cliff as a wall was the prototype of Tongyuan Gate. The Tongyuan Gate city wall is neatly and orderly built along the mountain cliff, commanding a high position, presenting a typical ancient city wall with mountain characteristics. With urban expansion, Tongyuan Gate is now located on the main road of Yuzhong, where four roads intersect. Every day there is heavy traffic and constant crowds; city life above and below the wall is leisurely and content. The pass originally used for war defense has now become a place where people live and work in peace and contentment; this over-600-year-old ancient city wall will continue to guard Chongqing City and the people of Chongqing.

projects.name: 东水门及城墙
projects.address: 渝中区望龙门东正街1号
projects.content_zh: 九开八闭十七门中保存较好的除了通远门，还有鲤跳龙门的东水门。从朝天门往南，重庆城墙大都建在长江边山崖上。东水门为老城正东的大门，城门向北，距朝天门约800米，与通远门同为明洪武年间遗址，门上城楼已不复存在，城墙现保存从芭蕉院到东水门下巷的古城墙约230米。城门宽3.1米、高4.5米、厚6.6米，属石卷顶城门洞。也许是其所处地势险要，易守难攻的缘故，该门未设瓮城，是开门中的中小城门。东水门是旧重庆的水码头之一，历史上是重庆城出城过长江到南岸的重要通道，也是到贵州、云南的必经之路。凭借水码头的优势，这一带曾是旧时城内最繁华的商业区之一，在通向水门的青石梯两边，商铺、茶楼、客栈、酒肆林立。这里也是会馆集中区，当时重庆城内有八大会馆，这里就集中了三所，即江南会馆、湖广会馆和广东会馆。后由于水码头迁至望龙门，东水门才逐渐衰落。如今，一道东水门长江大桥横跨大江，替代水门成为到南岸的通道。大桥下的旧城门远远地离开了我们的视线，过去城墙下的旧房被改建一新的黑瓦白墙的仿古建筑所替代，四周是开阔平坦的滨江公路，不时有汽车从这里急驶而过，让人很难想象这里曾经的市井繁华。只有长年累月被下来往的苦力与船客的双脚蹬踏的石阶上露出斑驳的痕迹，在多雨的时节里，散发出岁月的气息。
projects.content_en: Among the seventeen gates (nine open, eight closed) that are relatively well preserved, besides Tongyuan Gate, there is also Dongshui Gate of Carp Leaping the Dragon Gate. Going south from Chaotian Gate, most of Chongqing's city walls are built on the cliffs by the Yangtze River. Dongshui Gate was the main gate due east of the old city, with the gate facing north, about 800m from Chaotian Gate; it is a ruin from the same Ming Hongwu period as Tongyuan Gate. The gate tower on top no longer exists; the city wall currently preserves about 230m of ancient city wall from Bajiao Courtyard to Dongshui Gate Lower Alley. The city gate is 3.1m wide, 4.5m high, and 6.6m thick, belonging to a stone-vaulted gate opening. Perhaps due to its strategically dangerous terrain, easy to defend and difficult to attack, this gate did not have a barbican, and is a medium-small gate among the open gates. Dongshui Gate was one of the old Chongqing water wharves; historically it was an important passage out of Chongqing City across the Yangtze River to the south bank, and also the only way to Guizhou and Yunnan. By virtue of the water wharf advantage, this area was once one of the most prosperous commercial districts in the old city; on both sides of the bluestone steps leading to the water gate, shops, teahouses, inns, and taverns stood in great numbers. This was also a guild hall concentration area; at that time there were eight major guild halls in Chongqing city, and three were concentrated here — namely the Jiangnan Guild Hall, Huguang Guild Hall, and Guangdong Guild Hall. Later, because the water wharf moved to Wanglongmen, Dongshui Gate gradually declined. Today, a Dongshui Gate Yangtze River Bridge spans the great river, replacing the water gate as the passage to the south bank. The old city gate under the bridge has far left our sight; the old houses under the past city wall have been replaced by newly renovated black-tile white-wall antique buildings, surrounded by open and flat riverside roads, with cars speeding by from time to time, making it hard to imagine the past urban prosperity here. Only the mottled traces exposed on the stone steps, trodden for years by the feet of coolies and boat passengers coming and going, emit the breath of time in the rainy season.

projects.name: 湖广会馆
projects.address: 渝中区东水门正街4号
projects.content_zh: 在东水门向东南方向望去，不远处即是一大片古色古香的明清建筑——重庆湖广会馆建筑群。会馆是各地客商按籍贯在某一地方设立的办事处。过去人们出门在外，院里家乡亲友，遇事孤立无援，会馆则将一地的同乡同业者组织团结到一起，起到互帮互助、排难解纷的作用。历史上重庆明清时期的商业繁盛，吸引了外地大量商人进入重庆市场，尤其是两广、两湖和山西、陕西、福建、江西、云贵等省的商人。各商帮自乾隆时期就陆续在城里设立会馆。昔日重庆城著名的八大会馆，都具有相当的规模和经济实力，它们是湖广会馆(又名禹王宫，在东水门内)、江西会馆(又名万寿宫，在东水门内)、广东会馆(又名南华宫)、陕西会馆(又名三元庙，在朝天门内)、福建会馆(又名天后宫，在陕西街)、云贵会馆(在绣壁街)、山西会馆(在人和湾)、同庆公所等。当年的八大会馆中，建筑最宏伟气派的要数财力雄厚的湖广会馆和江西会馆。这两大会馆和相毗邻的广东公所都在商业集中繁华的下半城的东水门内，形成庞大的建筑群，也就是今天我们所统称的湖广会馆建筑群。如今参观湖广会馆，主要分为三部分：禹王宫，齐安公所，广东公所，另外还有两个博物馆：移民博物馆和匾额博物馆。禹王宫即湖广会馆，由早期移民中的湖南、湖北富商、乡绅捐资兴建，始建于清乾隆二十四年(1759年)，因祀大禹故名禹王宫。史料载湖广之名始于元代湖广行中书省，该省辖湖北、湖南全境及广东、广西部分。明代设湖广布政使司时，只辖湖北、湖南两省了，且湖广之名沿用，实际上湖广仅指两湖之城了。两湖之地水患严重，故有借禹王镇邪防灾的意思。殿前三重飞檐直插云霄，动感非常。正殿宽敞的天井前供奉着高大的禹王铜像，令人肃然起敬。每年正月，这里都要举行盛大的禹王庙会，祭祀大禹以求平安，活动内容丰富多彩，影响范围较大，受到人民群众的喜爱，因此这一习俗被沿袭下来，成为饶有趣味的过年内容。禹王宫大殿后面依山而上就是齐安公所和广东公所。齐安公所又名帝王宫，祭祀主宰天宫地官水官之神的三元大帝，由湖北黄州府移民修建，始建于清嘉庆年间，目前保留下来的建筑为清光绪年间重建。因为唐代湖北黄州一带曾设置过齐安郡，所以命名为齐安公所。齐安公所的大门与传统会馆大门建在中轴线不同，位于建筑侧面，斜向东方，朝向移民的家乡湖北黄州府方向，既有风水的讲究，也寄托了移民对祖籍地的思乡之情。广东公所又名南华宫，由广东移民捐资兴建。广东公所现存主体结构呈四合院布局，入口大门为牌楼式，四柱三间五楼，各楼翘角飞檐，楼面房脊、瓦垅、滴水俱全，上有广东公所四个金灿灿的大字。该会馆的后殿建筑在修建解放路小学时被拆除，叫人扼腕。要解读湖广会馆的精致，离不开会馆中的戏楼。禹王宫保留下的三面外伸的戏楼，两边有厢楼，专供贵宾、台下的场地供一般观众使用。戏台两边供配乐人员使用的乐楼很小，檐下的额枋雕刻着各种鬼怪故事。齐安公所的戏楼进深更大，专供贵宾的看厅在戏台的对面而不是两厢，乐楼也比禹王宫的大得多，额枋雕刻的内容已从鬼怪故事变为二十四孝图三国演义封神演义鱼樵图等，每个故事旁边都刻有寓意福气的蝙蝠、花草、瑞兽等。广东公所的戏楼是四座戏楼中保存最好、最为气派精致的。戏楼为木结构歇山式淡绿加黄色琉璃瓦顶，两侧耳楼为观戏楼厢，中为天井，后有看厅。此看厅雕刻非常丰富，卷棚檐口下，四个撑拱的镂空戏雕精美绝伦，是极其珍贵的戏曲文物。重庆戏曲在这一时期发展较快，当年的湖广会馆一年开戏200余次，差不多每两天就有一台戏看。开戏的目的多为看戏娱神，无论官商公子、富家小姐，还是袍哥大爷、青楼名媛，三教九流，每到下午戌时，看客爆满，人声鼎沸。湖广会馆的围墙样式，是明清时期常见的黄色封火墙，以直线构图而呈阶梯状叠落，又称码头墙，是典型的江南建筑风格。从对岸远远望去，湖广会馆的建筑从山坡上直冲而下，围墙连绵不断，给人震撼的视觉冲击。如今，无数的人们到这里寻根。川流不息的游客将目光锁定在一件件文物上，顾盼流连，议论纷纷。透过这些历尽沧桑的物品，人们仿佛看见了故土麻城的山岭，看见了八百里秦川，看见了洞庭湖上的帆影，看见了长江三峡的激流洪波，看见了漫长岁月里无数动人的故事，为之欣喜，为之感怀，为之拥有无穷无尽的力量。
projects.content_en: Looking southeast from Dongshui Gate, not far away is a large expanse of antique Ming-Qing buildings — the Chongqing Huguang Guild Hall building complex. A guild hall was an office established by merchants from various places according to their native place in a certain location. In the past, when people went out, away from home, with relatives and friends in their hometown, they were isolated and helpless in case of trouble; the guild hall organized and united fellow townsmen and fellow tradesmen from one place together, playing a role in mutual help and resolving disputes. Historically, the commercial prosperity of Chongqing during the Ming-Qing period attracted a large number of merchants from other places to enter the Chongqing market, especially merchants from Guangdong and Guangxi, Hubei and Hunan, and Shanxi, Shaanxi, Fujian, Jiangxi, Yunnan and Guizhou provinces. Various merchant groups successively established guild halls in the city from the Qianlong period. The famous eight major guild halls of old Chongqing City all had considerable scale and economic strength; they were the Huguang Guild Hall (also called Yuwang Palace, inside Dongshui Gate), Jiangxi Guild Hall (also called Wanshou Palace, inside Dongshui Gate), Guangdong Guild Hall (also called Nanhua Palace), Shaanxi Guild Hall (also called Sanyuan Temple, inside Chaotian Gate), Fujian Guild Hall (also called Tianhou Palace, on Shaanxi Street), Yunnan-Guizhou Guild Hall (on Xiubi Street), Shanxi Guild Hall (in Renhewan), and Tongqing Public Office, etc. Among the eight major guild halls of those days, the most grand and imposing buildings were the financially powerful Huguang Guild Hall and Jiangxi Guild Hall. These two major guild halls and the adjacent Guangdong Public Office were all inside Dongshui Gate in the prosperous lower half city with concentrated commerce, forming a庞大 building complex, which is what we collectively call the Huguang Guild Hall building complex today. Visiting Huguang Guild Hall today, it is mainly divided into three parts: Yuwang Palace, Qi'an Public Office, and Guangdong Public Office; in addition there are two museums: the Immigration Museum and the Plaque Museum. Yuwang Palace is the Huguang Guild Hall, built with donations from wealthy merchants and gentry of Hunan and Hubei among the early immigrants, first built in the 24th year of Qianlong (1759), Qing; because it sacrifices to Yu the Great, it is named Yuwang Palace. Historical records show that the name Huguang originated from the Huguang Branch Secretariat of Yuan dynasty, which governed the whole territory of Hubei and Hunan and parts of Guangdong and Guangxi. When the Huguang Administrative Commissioner was established in Ming, it only governed Hubei and Hunan provinces, and the name Huguang continued to be used, actually Huguang only referred to the two Hubei and Hunan regions. The two Hubei and Hunan regions had severe flood disasters, hence there was the meaning of borrowing Yu the Great to suppress evil and prevent disasters. In front of the hall, three layers of flying eaves pierce straight into the sky, very dynamic. In front of the spacious courtyard of the main hall, a tall bronze statue of Yu the Great is enshrined, making one feel awe-inspiring respect. Every first lunar month, a grand Yuwang Temple Fair is held here, sacrificing to Yu the Great to seek peace; the activities are rich and colorful, with a large influence range, loved by the people, hence this custom has been passed down, becoming an interesting New Year content. Going up the mountain behind the main hall of Yuwang Palace are the Qi'an Public Office and Guangdong Public Office. Qi'an Public Office, also called Diwang Palace, sacrifices to the Three Great Emperors who rule the gods of heaven, earth, and water; built by immigrants from Huangzhou Prefecture, Hubei, first built during the Qing Jiaqing era, the currently preserved buildings were rebuilt during the Qing Guangxu era. Because the area around Huangzhou, Hubei was once established as Qi'an Commandery in Tang dynasty, it was named Qi'an Public Office. The gate of Qi'an Public Office differs from traditional guild hall gates built on the central axis; it is located on the side of the building, slanting toward the east, facing the direction of the immigrants' hometown Huangzhou Prefecture, Hubei — both having fengshui considerations and entrusting the immigrants' homesickness for their ancestral home. Guangdong Public Office, also called Nanhua Palace, was built with donations from Guangdong immigrants. The currently preserved main structure of Guangdong Public Office has a siheyuan layout; the entrance gate is in archway style, with four columns, three bays, and five stories; each story has upturned corners and flying eaves, with roof ridges, tile ridges, and drips all complete on the building surface, with the four glittering characters Guangdong Public Office on top. The rear hall building of this guild hall was demolished when Jiefang Road Primary School was built, regrettable. To interpret the exquisiteness of Huguang Guild Hall, one cannot do without the theater towers in the guild hall. The three-sided outward-extending theater tower preserved by Yuwang Palace has wing towers on both sides, exclusively for distinguished guests; the area under the stage is for general audiences. The music towers on both sides of the stage for accompaniment personnel are very small; under the eaves, the architraves are carved with various ghost and monster stories. The theater tower of Qi'an Public Office has a greater depth; the viewing hall exclusively for distinguished guests is opposite the stage rather than on both sides, and the music tower is also much larger than that of Yuwang Palace; the content carved on the architraves has changed from ghost and monster stories to the Twenty-Four Filial Exemplars, Romance of the Three Kingdoms, Investiture of the Gods, Fisherman-Woodcutter Pictures, etc.; beside each story are carved bats, flowers and plants, and auspicious beasts symbolizing good fortune. The theater tower of Guangdong Public Office is the best preserved and most imposing and exquisite among the four theater towers. The theater tower is of timber structure with a xieshan-style light-green plus yellow glazed tile roof; the side ear towers on both sides are theater-viewing tower wings, with a courtyard in the middle and a viewing hall behind. This viewing hall has very rich carvings; under the curved eave opening, the openwork theatrical carvings of the four supporting brackets are exquisite beyond compare, being extremely precious opera cultural relics. Chongqing opera developed relatively fast during this period; in those days, Huguang Guild Hall held operas over 200 times a year, almost every two days there was an opera to watch. The purpose of holding operas was mostly to watch operas and entertain the gods; whether official and merchant young masters, wealthy young ladies, or Paoge (brotherhood) masters, famous courtesans, people of all walks of life, every afternoon at the xu hour (7-9pm), the audience was packed and voices were bustling. The wall style of Huguang Guild Hall is the yellow fire-sealing wall common in the Ming-Qing period, with straight-line composition presenting stepped cascading, also called wharf wall, a typical Jiangnan architectural style. Viewed from afar on the opposite bank, the buildings of Huguang Guild Hall rush straight down from the hillside, with continuous walls, giving a shocking visual impact. Today, countless people come here to seek their roots. The endless stream of tourists locks their eyes on each cultural relic, looking around and lingering, discussing. Through these weather-beaten objects, people as if see the mountains of their hometown Macheng, see the eight hundred li of Qinchuan, see the sail shadows on Dongting Lake, see the rapids and waves of the Three Gorges of the Yangtze, see countless moving stories in the long years, rejoicing for them, feeling for them, and possessing endless power from them.

projects.name: 东华观藏经楼
projects.name_en: Depository of Scriptures of Donghua Taoist Temple
projects.address: 渝中区凯旋路64号
projects.content_zh: 自唐代开始，重庆曾经是道教的重点活动地区，留下了宝贵的道观文化遗迹。在重庆市渝中区凯旋路上，就隐藏着这样一座距今已有700多年历史的道观遗迹——东华观藏经楼。东华观始建于隋，其后多次重修。明《蜀中名胜记》记载：城中有东华观，观后有东华十八洞，皆相通。今土人呼其处为神仙口，相传东华真君于此得道。可惜院中建筑多已毁坏，现仅存藏经阁。据《重庆渝中区文史资料》记载，东华观藏经楼修建于元代，重建于明。如今的藏经楼掩映于绿荫之下，整体构架破败不堪。过去的琉璃瓦，在风吹雨打之下已呈青色。檐角残缺不全，瓦当、木梁被腐蚀成了黑色，摇摇欲坠。憔悴的外表之下还有它外的命运。1939年，该楼被日军轰炸，内藏的部分经书及建筑被炸毁。文革时期，楼内供奉的神像全部遭到毁坏。1962年，该楼又突遭大火焚烧。后来重庆印刷厂一一厂房逐渐占据了藏经楼正门，至今没有搬迁。藏经楼现存建筑面积不到原先的三分之一。过去东华观大门两侧有过这样一副对联：看涂山云影飞来无限天光供一府，问字水梅花开放几分春色到三巴。风光已逝，空余此楼，如果没有人们的关注和保护，所有的记忆将和它一起，继续沉睡。
projects.content_en: Since Tang dynasty, Chongqing was once a key activity area for Daoism, leaving precious Taoist temple cultural relics. On Kaixuan Road, Yuzhong District, Chongqing City, there hides such a Taoist temple ruin with a history of over 700 years — the Depository of Scriptures of Donghua Taoist Temple. Donghua Taoist Temple was first built in Sui dynasty, and later rebuilt multiple times. The Ming dynasty Scenic Spots of Shu records: In the city there is Donghua Taoist Temple; behind the temple there are eighteen Donghua caves, all connected. Today locals call this place Shenxian (Immortal) Mouth; legend has it that the Donghua True Lord attained the Dao here. Unfortunately, most of the buildings in the temple have been destroyed, and now only the Scripture Depository survives. According to the Cultural and Historical Materials of Yuzhong District, Chongqing, the Scripture Depository of Donghua Taoist Temple was built in Yuan dynasty and rebuilt in Ming. Today's Scripture Depository is hidden under green shade, with its overall frame in ruins. The past glazed tiles have turned blue under wind and rain. The eave corners are incomplete, and the tile ends and timber beams have corroded into black, crumbling. Beneath its haggard appearance is also its external fate. In 1939, this building was bombed by the Japanese army, and part of the scriptures and buildings stored inside were blown up. During the Cultural Revolution, all the deity statues enshrined inside the building were destroyed. In 1962, this building suddenly suffered a fire again. Later, a factory building of Chongqing Printing Factory gradually occupied the main entrance of the Scripture Depository, and has not been relocated to this day. The existing building area of the Scripture Depository is less than one-third of the original. In the past, on both sides of the main gate of Donghua Taoist Temple there was such a couplet: Watching the cloud shadows of Tushan Mountain fly in, infinite heavenly light serves one prefecture; asking the plum blossoms of Zishui to bloom, how much spring color reaches the Three Ba.
